policy: Draft registry of standard TCM disease names (中醫內科學/婦科學/外科學 chapter level). Ids are permanent. related_* back-links filled by validation pass in E3.

records.definition_zh: 感冒是外邪侵襲肺衛，以鼻塞流涕、噴嚏、頭痛、惡寒發熱、全身不適為主要表現的常見外感病，四時皆可發生，尤以冬春季節多見，有一定傳染性。
records.definition_en: Gan Mao (TCM Common Cold) is an externally-contracted disorder in which a pathogen invades the Lung and the defensive (Wei) level, presenting with nasal congestion, sneezing, headache, aversion to cold with fever, and general malaise. It occurs year-round, is most common in winter and spring, and can be mildly contagious.
records.etiology_zh: 外因為風邪夾寒、熱、暑濕等當令之氣侵襲體表衛分；內因為衛外功能不固，多見於肺脾氣虛之人、起居失宜、氣候驟變或過度勞累之後。
records.etiology_en: The external cause is invasion of the exterior Wei level by Wind combined with seasonal Cold, Heat, or Summerheat-Dampness. The internal predisposition is a poorly consolidated defensive Qi, most often in those with underlying Lung-Spleen Qi deficiency, irregular routines, sudden weather change, or overexertion.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 風邪襲表，首犯肺衛：衛陽被遏則惡寒，正邪相爭於表則發熱，肺氣失宣則鼻塞、噴嚏、咳嗽。素體虛弱者衛外不固，易反覆感邪、纏綿難癒，除風寒、風熱、暑濕三大常見類型外，尚有氣虛感冒、陰虛感冒等體虛夾外邪的類型，惟現行 pattern.* 詞彙表暫未收錄對應的專用證型 id。
records.pathomechanism_en: Wind pathogens attack the exterior, first invading the Lung-Wei level: obstruction of defensive Yang produces aversion to cold, the struggle between correct and pathogenic Qi at the exterior produces fever, and loss of the Lung's dispersing function produces nasal congestion, sneezing, and cough. In those with an underlying vacuity, a poorly consolidated Wei Qi allows repeated, protracted invasion. Beyond the three common Wind-Cold / Wind-Heat / Summerheat-Damp types, textbooks also describe Qi-deficiency and Yin-deficiency cold types (vacuity complicated by an external pathogen), though the current pattern.* vocabulary has no dedicated id for these compound types yet.
key_manifestations_zh: 鼻塞流涕
噴嚏
惡寒發熱
頭痛
全身痠痛
咽癢或咽痛
key_manifestations_en: Nasal congestion and discharge
Sneezing
Aversion to cold with fever
Headache
Generalized body aches
Itchy or sore throat
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在肺、衛表；體虛易感者涉及脾。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Lung and the exterior Wei level; the Spleen is involved in those prone to recurrent invasion from underlying vacuity.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 疏風解表為總則：風寒證辛溫解表，風熱證辛涼解表，暑濕證清暑祛濕解表；體虛感冒者兼顧扶正。
records.treatment_principle_en: The overall principle is to disperse Wind and release the exterior: acrid-warm release for Wind-Cold, acrid-cool release for Wind-Heat, and clearing Summerheat with Dampness resolution for Summerheat-Damp presentations; vacuity-type colds additionally require supporting the correct Qi.

red_flags_zh.finding: 高燒不退（≧3天）或反覆發燒
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速回診評估，考慮續發性細菌感染
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為鼻竇炎、中耳炎、肺炎等細菌性併發症，而非單純病毒性感冒
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus - How to treat the common cold at home (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000466.htm)

red_flags_zh.finding: 呼吸困難、突發胸痛或腹痛、意識混亂、劇烈嘔吐不止
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即急診或撥打當地緊急號碼
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示肺炎或其他心肺、神經系統急症，已超出單純感冒範圍
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus - How to treat the common cold at home (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000466.htm)

red_flags_zh.finding: 症狀10天以上未改善，或好轉後又惡化
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示續發感染或非單純病毒性上呼吸道感染
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus - How to treat the common cold at home (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000466.htm)

red_flags_en.finding: Fever that persists ≥3 days, or recurring fever
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Prompt follow-up evaluation, consider secondary bacterial infection
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate sinusitis, otitis media, pneumonia, or another bacterial complication rather than a simple viral cold
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus - How to treat the common cold at home (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000466.htm)

red_flags_en.finding: Difficulty breathing, sudden chest or abdominal pain, confusion, or severe unremitting vomiting
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests pneumonia or another cardiopulmonary/neurologic emergency beyond a simple cold
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus - How to treat the common cold at home (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000466.htm)

red_flags_en.finding: Symptoms not improving after 10+ days, or improving then worsening again
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests a secondary infection rather than a simple viral URI
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus - How to treat the common cold at home (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000466.htm)

records.definition_zh: 咳嗽是肺失宣降、肺氣上逆所致，以咳嗽咳痰為主症的病證，可因外感或內傷引起，是肺系疾病最常見的主症之一。
records.definition_en: Ke Sou (Cough) is a disease caused by the Lung losing its dispersing-descending function so that Lung Qi rebels upward, presenting mainly with coughing and expectoration. It may arise from external contraction or internal damage and is one of the most common presentations in Lung-system disease.
records.etiology_zh: 外感者為六淫（風寒、風熱、燥邪等）侵襲肺系；內傷者為他臟功能失調犯肺，如脾失健運聚濕生痰、肝火犯肺、肺陰虧虛等。
records.etiology_en: External-contraction cough arises when one of the six pathogenic factors (Wind-Cold, Wind-Heat, Dryness, etc.) invades the Lung system. Internal-damage cough arises when dysfunction of another organ affects the Lung — for example, Spleen failing to transform fluids and generating Phlegm, Liver Fire invading the Lung, or Lung Yin depletion.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肺為嬌臟，主宣發肅降；外邪襲肺或痰濁、肝火內擾，皆令肺氣壅遏、失於宣降而上逆作咳。久咳可傷肺氣、肺陰，或反覆感邪，遷延難癒。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Lung is a delicate organ governing dispersal and descent. Whether from an external pathogen attacking the Lung, or internal Phlegm-turbidity or Liver Fire disturbing it, the result is Lung Qi obstruction and loss of the descending function, producing rebellious cough. Chronic cough can injure Lung Qi or Lung Yin, or predispose to recurrent external invasion with a protracted course.
key_manifestations_zh: 咳嗽
咳痰（性狀因證而異）
咽癢或咽痛
胸悶
遇風冷或異味誘發加重
key_manifestations_en: Cough
Expectoration (character varies by pattern)
Itchy or sore throat
Chest oppression
Aggravated by wind, cold, or strong odors
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在肺，與脾、肝、腎密切相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Lung, closely related to the Spleen, Liver, and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 外感咳嗽以疏風宣肺為主，隨寒熱燥濕加減；內傷咳嗽當辨臟腑虛實，健脾化痰、清肝瀉肺或滋陰潤肺。
records.treatment_principle_en: External-contraction cough is primarily treated by dispersing Wind and diffusing the Lung, modified for cold, heat, or dryness; internal-damage cough requires differentiating the affected organ and its vacuity/excess status — fortifying the Spleen to transform Phlegm, clearing the Liver and draining the Lung, or nourishing Yin to moisten the Lung.

red_flags_zh.finding: 咳血（咳痰帶血或大量咯血）
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 任何咳血都應儘速就醫評估；大量咯血、合併胸痛、頭暈或發燒須立即就醫
red_flags_zh.rationale: 咳血可能提示肺癌、肺結核、支氣管擴張或肺栓塞等嚴重疾病

red_flags_zh.finding: 呼吸困難、吸氣時高音調喘鳴聲（stridor）、突發劇烈咳嗽
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示氣道阻塞或嚴重呼吸道急症

red_flags_zh.finding: 咳嗽超過10-14天不癒、發燒、不明原因體重減輕或夜間盜汗
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘快就醫評估，排除細菌感染或肺結核
red_flags_zh.rationale: 持續咳嗽合併體重減輕、夜汗為肺結核警訊；發燒提示細菌性感染

red_flags_en.finding: Coughing up blood (blood-streaked sputum or frank hemoptysis)
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Contact a provider any time you cough up blood; seek immediate care for large amounts of blood or if accompanied by chest pain, dizziness, or fever
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate lung cancer, tuberculosis, bronchiectasis, or pulmonary embolism

red_flags_en.finding: Shortness of breath, high-pitched sound on inhaling (stridor), or a violent cough that begins rapidly
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call emergency services or seek immediate care
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests airway obstruction or a severe respiratory emergency

red_flags_en.finding: Cough lasting longer than 10-14 days, fever, unintentional weight loss, or night sweats
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Prompt evaluation to rule out bacterial infection or tuberculosis
red_flags_en.rationale: Persistent cough with weight loss and night sweats is a TB warning sign; fever suggests bacterial infection

records.definition_zh: 哮病是一種反覆發作的痰鳴氣喘病證，以喉中哮鳴有聲、呼吸急促困難，甚則張口抬肩、不能平臥為特徵，多與宿痰內伏、外邪引動有關。
records.definition_en: Xiao Bing (Wheezing Disease) is a recurrent disease characterized by phlegm-rattling and dyspnea, marked by wheezing sounds in the throat and rapid, labored breathing, with severe cases showing mouth agape, shoulders raised, and inability to lie flat; it is closely tied to latent phlegm stirred by external triggers.
records.etiology_zh: 主因痰飲內伏於肺，遇外感、飲食、情志、勞倦等誘因觸動而發；素體肺、脾、腎虛損，痰飲難化，伏藏於肺為發病的夙根。
records.etiology_en: Mainly caused by latent Phlegm-Rheum concealed in the Lung, triggered by external contraction, diet, emotion, or overexertion; constitutional Lung-Spleen-Kidney deficiency prevents the Phlegm-Rheum from being transformed, and this latent Phlegm is the root predisposition for the disease.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 痰伏於肺，遇誘因觸動，痰隨氣升，氣因痰阻，相互搏結，壅塞氣道，肺失宣降，發為哮鳴氣喘；久發不已，肺脾腎俱虛，轉為虛哮或哮喘並見。
records.pathomechanism_en: Phlegm latent in the Lung is stirred by a trigger; Phlegm rises with Qi while Qi is obstructed by Phlegm, the two binding together to block the airway and impair the Lung's dispersal and descent, producing wheezing and dyspnea. With prolonged recurrence the Lung, Spleen, and Kidney all become deficient, and the pattern may shift toward deficiency-type wheezing or combine with dyspnea pattern disease.
key_manifestations_zh: 喉中哮鳴有聲，呼吸急促
胸悶如塞
甚則張口抬肩，不能平臥
痰質粘稠或稀薄，咳吐不爽
反覆發作，遇誘因即發
緩解期可如常人或見肺脾腎虛象
key_manifestations_en: Wheezing sounds in the throat with rapid breathing
Chest oppression as if blocked
Severe cases: mouth agape, shoulders raised, unable to lie flat
Sputum thick-sticky or thin, difficult to expectorate
Recurrent attacks triggered by exposures
Between attacks may appear normal or show Lung-Spleen-Kidney deficiency signs
records.disease_location_zh: 病位主要在肺,與脾、腎關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is mainly the Lung, closely related to the Spleen and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 發時攻邪治標,祛痰利氣,寒哮溫肺散寒化痰,熱哮清熱化痰宣肺;平時扶正治本,補肺健脾益腎,分別調補肺脾腎。
records.treatment_principle_en: During attacks, attack the pathogen to treat the branch: expel Phlegm and regulate Qi, warming the Lung and dispersing Cold for cold-type wheezing, clearing Heat and transforming Phlegm for heat-type wheezing. Between attacks, support upright Qi to treat the root: tonify Lung, strengthen Spleen, and benefit Kidney as indicated.

red_flags_zh.finding: 講話或走動都因呼吸困難而變得吃力
red_flags_zh.rationale: 重度氣喘發作徵象

red_flags_zh.finding: 嘴唇或指甲發紺（發青發灰），或意識混亂、反應變差
red_flags_zh.rationale: 缺氧及嚴重發作徵象

red_flags_zh.finding: 使用速效緩解藥物後症狀未改善
red_flags_zh.rationale: 治療無效顯示嚴重發作，需緊急醫療處置

red_flags_en.finding: Trouble walking or talking because it is so hard to breathe
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call 911 / go to emergency department immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: Sign of a severe asthma attack

red_flags_en.finding: Lips or fingernails blue or gray, or confused / less responsive than usual
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Go to the emergency department immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: Signs of hypoxia and severe attack

red_flags_en.finding: Symptoms do not improve after using quick-relief/rescue medicine
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call 911 / go to emergency department immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: Treatment failure indicates a severe attack requiring emergency care

records.definition_zh: 喘證是以呼吸急促、甚則張口抬肩、鼻煽、不能平臥為主要表現的病證，可由多種急慢性肺系及其他臟腑疾病引起，較哮病範圍更廣，不一定伴喉中哮鳴聲。
records.definition_en: Chuan Zheng (Dyspnea Pattern Disease) is characterized by rapid, labored breathing, with severe cases showing mouth agape, shoulders raised, flaring nostrils, and inability to lie flat; it may arise from many acute and chronic Lung-system and other organ diseases, is broader in scope than Xiao Bing, and does not necessarily involve audible wheezing.
records.etiology_zh: 外感風寒、風熱、痰濁壅肺；內傷者多因肺氣不足、脾失健運、腎不納氣，或水飲、瘀血犯肺。
records.etiology_en: External contraction of Wind-Cold, Wind-Heat, or Phlegm-turbidity obstructing the Lung; internal-damage cases are usually due to Lung Qi insufficiency, Spleen failing to transport, Kidney failing to grasp Qi, or Water-Rheum and Blood stasis invading the Lung.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肺為氣之主，腎為氣之根；外邪、痰濁、水飲壅塞肺氣，肺失宣降則喘；久病肺脾腎俱虛，腎失攝納，氣不歸元，則喘促益甚，動則尤甚。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Lung governs Qi and the Kidney is the root of Qi. External pathogens, Phlegm-turbidity, or Water-Rheum obstruct Lung Qi and impair its dispersal and descent, producing dyspnea. With chronic disease the Lung, Spleen, and Kidney all become deficient; the Kidney loses its grasping function so Qi fails to return to its root, worsening the dyspnea, especially on exertion.
key_manifestations_zh: 呼吸急促，甚則張口抬肩
不能平臥，動則喘甚
或伴咳嗽、咯痰
虛喘者呼多吸少，氣不得續
實喘者聲高氣粗，痰鳴漉漉
key_manifestations_en: Rapid, labored breathing, severe cases with mouth agape and shoulders raised
Unable to lie flat, worse with exertion
May accompany cough with sputum
Deficiency-type: exhalation predominates over inhalation, breath cannot be sustained
Excess-type: loud, coarse breathing with rattling phlegm sounds
records.disease_location_zh: 病位主要在肺、腎，亦與心、肝相關；久喘及心則見心悸、唇甲青紫。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is mainly the Lung and Kidney, also related to the Heart and Liver; chronic dyspnea affecting the Heart presents with palpitations and cyanotic lips/nails.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 實喘祛邪利氣，分寒熱化痰；虛喘培補攝納，補肺、健脾、益腎，分清標本虛實，虛實夾雜者當標本兼顧。
records.treatment_principle_en: Excess-type dyspnea: expel the pathogen and regulate Qi, transforming Phlegm according to Cold or Heat. Deficiency-type dyspnea: tonify and consolidate the grasping function via tonifying Lung, strengthening Spleen, and benefiting Kidney. Distinguish root from branch and excess from deficiency; mixed presentations require treating both.

red_flags_zh.finding: 突然發生的呼吸困難，嚴重影響呼吸甚至說話
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為急性心衰竭、肺栓塞或氣道阻塞

red_flags_zh.finding: 呼吸困難合併胸部不適、疼痛或壓迫感（心絞痛症狀）
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即就醫評估心臟疾病
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能合併急性冠心症候群

red_flags_zh.finding: 稍微活動或靜息時即感呼吸困難，或夜間喘醒需坐起呼吸
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示心衰竭或嚴重肺部疾病

red_flags_en.finding: Breathing difficulty comes on suddenly or seriously interferes with breathing and even talking
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Go to the emergency department / call 911 immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate acute heart failure, pulmonary embolism, or airway obstruction

red_flags_en.finding: Breathing difficulty with chest discomfort, pain, or pressure (angina symptoms)
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek immediate evaluation for cardiac disease
red_flags_en.rationale: May co-occur with acute coronary syndrome

red_flags_en.finding: Shortness of breath after only slight activity or at rest, or waking at night needing to sit up to breathe
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests heart failure or serious lung disease

records.definition_zh: 鼻鼽是以突發和反覆發作的鼻癢、噴嚏、大量清涕、鼻塞為主要表現的鼻病，多因肺、脾、腎虛損，衛表不固，風邪乘虛侵襲鼻竅所致。
records.definition_en: Bi Qiu (Allergic Rhinorrhea) is a nasal disease characterized by sudden, recurrent nasal itching, sneezing, profuse clear discharge, and nasal congestion, usually due to Lung-Spleen-Kidney deficiency and an unconsolidated defensive exterior allowing Wind to invade the nasal orifice.
records.etiology_zh: 稟賦不耐，肺氣虛弱，衛表不固，風寒異氣乘虛而入；或脾氣虛弱，肺失濡養；或腎陽不足，攝納無權，鼻竅失於溫煦。
records.etiology_en: Constitutional intolerance with Lung Qi weakness and an unconsolidated defensive exterior allows Wind-Cold or allergenic influences to invade; or Spleen Qi weakness fails to nourish the Lung; or Kidney Yang insufficiency loses its grasping/warming function, leaving the nasal orifice without warmth.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肺開竅於鼻，肺氣虛則衛外不固，風邪易犯清竅，邪正相搏，鼻竅壅塞，津液不能布散反從鼻竅溢出而為清涕；病久及脾腎，則反覆難癒。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Lung opens into the nose; Lung Qi deficiency weakens the defensive exterior, allowing Wind to easily invade the clear orifice. The struggle between pathogen and upright Qi obstructs the nasal passage, and fluids that fail to be distributed normally leak out as clear discharge. Chronic disease extends to the Spleen and Kidney, producing a recurrent, difficult-to-resolve course.
key_manifestations_zh: 鼻癢、噴嚏連作
鼻塞、大量清稀鼻涕
遇冷風、異味或晨起即發
可伴目癢、咽癢
反覆發作，緩解期如常人
key_manifestations_en: Nasal itching with successive sneezing
Nasal congestion with copious thin clear discharge
Triggered by cold wind, odors, or on waking
May accompany itchy eyes or throat
Recurrent episodes; asymptomatic between attacks
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在肺、鼻，與脾、腎關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Lung and nose, closely related to the Spleen and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 治宜溫肺散寒、益氣固表，或健脾益氣，或溫補腎陽，標本兼治，緩解期以扶正固本為主。
records.treatment_principle_en: Treatment warms the Lung and disperses Cold while tonifying Qi to consolidate the exterior, or strengthens the Spleen and tonifies Qi, or warmly tonifies Kidney Yang, treating root and branch together; between attacks, focus on supporting upright Qi and consolidating the root.

red_flags_zh.finding: 嚴重鼻過敏症狀持續影響日常生活
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 安排耳鼻喉科或過敏科評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除氣喘等共病並評估是否需免疫治療

red_flags_zh.finding: 曾經有效的治療方式不再有效，或症狀對治療完全無反應
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示需重新評估診斷，或合併鼻竇炎等併發症

red_flags_en.finding: Severe hay fever symptoms persistently affecting daily life
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Arrange ENT or allergy specialist evaluation
red_flags_en.rationale: Need to rule out comorbid asthma and assess for immunotherapy

red_flags_en.finding: Treatment that once worked no longer works, or symptoms do not respond to treatment
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests need to reassess diagnosis or check for complications such as sinusitis

records.definition_zh: 鼻淵是以鼻塞、鼻涕量多、色黃質稠、有臭味，伴頭痛、嗅覺減退為主要表現的鼻病，多因外邪犯肺、膽經鬱熱、脾胃濕熱上蒸鼻竅所致。
records.definition_en: Bi Yuan (Deep-Source Nasal Congestion / sinusitis) is a nasal disease characterized by nasal congestion, profuse thick yellow malodorous discharge, headache, and diminished sense of smell, usually due to external pathogens invading the Lung, Gallbladder-channel depressive heat, or Spleen-Stomach Damp-Heat steaming up to the nasal orifice.
records.etiology_zh: 外感風寒風熱失於表散，鬱而化熱；或膽經濕熱、脾胃濕熱循經上犯鼻竅；久病肺脾氣虛，邪毒滯留鼻竅。
records.etiology_en: External Wind-Cold or Wind-Heat that fails to be dispersed at the exterior turns into depressive Heat; or Gallbladder-channel or Spleen-Stomach Damp-Heat travels along the channel to invade the nasal orifice; chronic disease causes Lung-Spleen Qi deficiency, allowing pathogenic toxin to linger in the nose.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 邪熱蘊結鼻竅，灼傷鼻膜，腐液成涕，故涕黃濁腥臭；久病傷及肺脾之氣，清陽不升，邪毒稽留，則反覆纏綿難癒。
records.pathomechanism_en: Pathogenic Heat accumulates in the nasal orifice and scorches the nasal membrane, putrefying fluids into discharge, producing thick yellow malodorous mucus. Chronic disease injures Lung and Spleen Qi so clear Yang fails to ascend, and lingering pathogenic toxin causes a stubborn, recurrent course.
key_manifestations_zh: 鼻塞持續
膿涕量多，色黃綠，質稠有臭味
頭痛，前額或顴部脹痛
嗅覺減退
可伴發熱、咽痛
key_manifestations_en: Persistent nasal congestion
Copious thick, yellow-green, malodorous discharge
Headache with frontal or malar distending pain
Diminished sense of smell
May accompany fever or sore throat
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在鼻竅，與肺、膽、脾胃相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the nasal orifice, related to the Lung, Gallbladder, and Spleen-Stomach.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 初起疏風清熱、宣肺通竅；膽熱、濕熱者清膽瀉熱或清脾瀉熱；久病肺脾氣虛者益氣固表、通利鼻竅，標本兼顧。
records.treatment_principle_en: Early stage: disperse Wind, clear Heat, and open the nasal orifice via Lung dispersal. Gallbladder-Heat or Damp-Heat patterns: clear Gallbladder or Spleen Heat. Chronic Lung-Spleen Qi deficiency: tonify Qi to consolidate the exterior and open the nasal passage, addressing root and branch together.

red_flags_zh.finding: 症狀持續超過10-14天，或感冒在7天後反而惡化
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 安排門診評估是否需抗生素治療
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示可能為細菌性鼻竇炎

red_flags_zh.finding: 鼻竇炎病程中出現視力變化，或眼周紅腫
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示眶周蜂窩性組織炎、腦膜炎、腦膿瘍等罕見但嚴重併發症

red_flags_zh.finding: 劇烈頭痛且一般止痛藥無法緩解，合併發燒
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速就醫，必要時安排影像學檢查
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除顱內併發症

red_flags_en.finding: Symptoms last longer than 10-14 days, or a cold gets worse after 7 days
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Arrange outpatient evaluation for possible antibiotic treatment
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests possible bacterial sinusitis

red_flags_en.finding: Changes in vision during a sinus infection, or redness/swelling around the eye
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Go to the emergency department immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests rare but serious complications such as orbital cellulitis, meningitis, or brain abscess

red_flags_en.finding: Severe headache not relieved by over-the-counter pain medicine, with fever
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek prompt evaluation, imaging if needed
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out intracranial complications

records.definition_zh: 乳蛾是以咽部兩側喉核（扁桃體）紅腫疼痛、吞嚥不利為主要表現的咽喉病，多因外感風熱邪毒，或肺胃積熱上攻咽喉所致。
records.definition_en: Ru E (Tonsillar Swelling) is a throat disease characterized by redness, swelling, and pain of the tonsils on both sides of the throat with difficulty swallowing, usually due to external Wind-Heat toxin or Lung-Stomach accumulated Heat attacking the throat.
records.etiology_zh: 外感風熱邪毒，從口鼻而入，侵犯咽喉；或恣食辛辣炙煿，肺胃積熱，循經上攻喉核；反覆發作者多屬肺腎陰虛，虛火上炎。
records.etiology_en: External Wind-Heat toxin enters through the mouth and nose to invade the throat; or excessive consumption of spicy, fried, roasted food generates Lung-Stomach accumulated Heat that travels up the channel to attack the tonsils; recurrent cases are usually due to Lung-Kidney Yin deficiency with deficient Fire flaring upward.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 風熱邪毒或肺胃之熱循經上壅咽喉，搏結喉核，氣血壅滯，化腐成膿，故見喉核紅腫疼痛，甚則潰爛化膿；久病陰傷，虛火上炎，則反覆發作。
records.pathomechanism_en: Wind-Heat toxin or Lung-Stomach Heat travels up the channel to congest the throat and bind at the tonsils; Qi and Blood stagnate and putrefy into pus, producing redness, swelling, and pain, with severe cases showing ulceration and suppuration. Chronic disease injures Yin, and deficient Fire flaring upward causes recurrent attacks.
key_manifestations_zh: 咽痛，吞嚥時加劇
喉核紅腫，甚則有黃白膿點
發熱、惡寒
頸部臖核腫痛
反覆發作者可見咽乾、喉核肥大
key_manifestations_en: Sore throat, worse on swallowing
Red, swollen tonsils, severe cases with yellow-white purulent spots
Fever and aversion to cold
Swollen, tender cervical lymph nodes
Recurrent cases: dry throat and enlarged tonsils
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在喉核（扁桃體），與肺、胃、腎相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the tonsils, related to the Lung, Stomach, and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 風熱外襲者疏風清熱、利咽消腫；肺胃熱盛者清熱解毒、瀉火利咽；陰虛火旺反覆發作者滋陰降火、利咽散結。
records.treatment_principle_en: Wind-Heat invasion: disperse Wind and clear Heat to benefit the throat and reduce swelling. Lung-Stomach Heat excess: clear Heat and resolve toxin, drain Fire and benefit the throat. Recurrent Yin-deficiency Fire-flaring cases: nourish Yin and downbear Fire, benefit the throat and dissipate nodulation.

red_flags_zh.finding: 呼吸困難、出現高調喘鳴聲（stridor），或呼吸時肋間肌肉凹陷
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即送急診，可能需緊急處置呼吸道
red_flags_zh.rationale: 腫脹組織可能阻塞呼吸道，屬致命急症

red_flags_zh.finding: 吞嚥困難、頸部轉動困難、口水直流（無法吞嚥自身唾液）
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示扁桃體周圍膿瘍形成，可能危及呼吸道

red_flags_en.finding: Breathing trouble with high-pitched breathing sounds (stridor), or retraction of the muscles between the ribs when breathing
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Go to the emergency department immediately; airway management may be needed
red_flags_en.rationale: Swollen tissue can block the airway, a life-threatening emergency

red_flags_en.finding: Difficulty swallowing, difficulty turning the head, or drooling (unable to swallow own saliva)
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Go to the emergency department immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests peritonsillar abscess formation with potential airway compromise

records.definition_zh: 胃痛是以上腹胃脘部近心窩處疼痛為主症的病證，常兼見脹滿、噯氣、泛酸、噁心嘔吐等症。
records.definition_en: Wei Tong (Stomach Pain) is a disease characterized primarily by pain in the epigastric region near the xiphoid, often accompanied by distension, belching, acid regurgitation, nausea, and vomiting.
records.etiology_zh: 多因飲食不節（過飢過飽、嗜食生冷辛辣）、情志不遂（肝氣犯胃）、外感寒邪內客於胃，或脾胃素虛所致。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by dietary irregularity (over-eating, fasting, or excessive cold/raw or spicy food), emotional stress (Liver Qi invading the Stomach), external Cold lodging in the Stomach, or an underlying Spleen-Stomach vacuity.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 胃主受納、以通降為順；飲食積滯、肝氣橫逆犯胃,或寒邪客胃,皆令胃氣壅滯、不通則痛;久病傷及脾胃陽氣或胃陰,則轉為虛證,不榮則痛。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Stomach governs intake and functions best when its Qi descends freely. Food stagnation, Liver Qi invading the Stomach, or Cold lodging in the Stomach all cause Stomach Qi to become obstructed — "no free flow, hence pain." Chronic disease injuring Spleen-Stomach Yang or Stomach Yin shifts the pattern toward vacuity — "no nourishment, hence pain."
key_manifestations_zh: 胃脘疼痛（脹痛、刺痛或隱痛，隨證不同）
脘腹脹滿
噯氣或泛酸
食慾不振
疼痛與飲食、情緒相關
key_manifestations_en: Epigastric pain (distending, stabbing, or dull, depending on pattern)
Epigastric fullness/distension
Belching or acid regurgitation
Poor appetite
Pain related to diet or emotional state
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在胃，與肝、脾關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Stomach, closely related to the Liver and Spleen.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以理氣和胃止痛為總則：肝氣犯胃者疏肝理氣，食滯者消食導滯，胃熱者清熱和胃，血瘀者活血化瘀，脾胃虛寒者溫中健脾，胃陰虧虛者養陰益胃。
records.treatment_principle_en: The overall principle is to regulate Qi, harmonize the Stomach, and stop pain: for Liver Qi invading the Stomach, soothe the Liver and regulate Qi; for food stagnation, disperse food and guide out stagnation; for Stomach Heat, clear Heat and harmonize the Stomach; for Blood stasis, invigorate Blood; for Spleen-Stomach Yang deficiency, warm the Middle and fortify the Spleen; for Stomach Yin deficiency, nourish Yin and benefit the Stomach.

red_flags_zh.finding: 胸、下顎、頸部或手臂疼痛
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除心臟事件（如心肌梗塞）偽裝成上腹痛

red_flags_zh.finding: 頻繁嘔吐或嘔血、黑色柏油樣糞便
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示消化道出血
red_flags_zh.source: reused from data/pathology/red_flag_registry.json entity cond.functional_dyspepsia / cond.chronic_gastritis (rf.functional_dyspepsia.legacy03/08, rf.chronic_gastritis.gastric_bleeding)

red_flags_zh.finding: 突發、劇烈且持續不退的腹痛
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除消化性潰瘍穿孔等急腹症

red_flags_zh.finding: 非刻意體重減輕、吞嚥困難或疼痛、眼睛或皮膚發黃
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除惡性腫瘤、食道病變或膽道阻塞

red_flags_en.finding: Pain in the chest, jaw, neck, or arm
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out a cardiac event (e.g., myocardial infarction) masquerading as epigastric pain

red_flags_en.finding: Frequent vomiting or bloody vomit, black tarry stools
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests gastrointestinal bleeding
red_flags_en.source: reused from data/pathology/red_flag_registry.json entity cond.functional_dyspepsia / cond.chronic_gastritis (rf.functional_dyspepsia.legacy03/08, rf.chronic_gastritis.gastric_bleeding)

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden, sharp, or severe abdominal pain that doesn't go away
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out an acute abdomen such as a perforated peptic ulcer

red_flags_en.finding: Unintentional weight loss, difficulty or pain swallowing, or yellowing of the eyes or skin
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out malignancy, esophageal disease, or biliary obstruction

records.definition_zh: 痞滿是以自覺胃脘部痞塞、脹滿不舒，按之柔軟、壓之無痛、視之無脹形為主要表現的病證，多因脾胃升降失常、氣機壅滯所致。
records.definition_en: Pi Man (Glomus and Fullness) is characterized by a subjective sensation of fullness and blockage in the epigastrium, soft on palpation, non-tender, and without visible distension, usually due to disordered Spleen-Stomach ascent/descent and Qi stagnation.
records.etiology_zh: 飲食不節、情志失調、脾胃虛弱、外邪內陷，均可致中焦氣機阻滯；或因誤下傷中，脾胃受損，升降失司。
records.etiology_en: Dietary irregularity, emotional disturbance, Spleen-Stomach weakness, or an external pathogen sinking inward can all obstruct middle-burner Qi movement; or improper purgation injures the middle, damaging the Spleen-Stomach and disrupting ascent/descent.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 脾胃為氣機升降之樞紐，凡食滯、痰濕、氣鬱、寒熱錯雜或脾胃虛弱，皆可致清陽不升、濁陰不降，壅塞於中，發為痞滿。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Spleen and Stomach are the pivot of Qi ascent and descent. Food stagnation, Phlegm-Damp, Qi depression, mixed Cold-Heat, or Spleen-Stomach weakness can all prevent clear Yang from ascending and turbid Yin from descending, causing obstruction in the middle and producing glomus and fullness.
key_manifestations_zh: 胃脘痞塞不舒，脹滿
按之柔軟不痛
食後加重
可伴噯氣、納呆
情緒或飲食失調時誘發加重
key_manifestations_en: Epigastric blockage and fullness discomfort
Soft, non-tender on palpation
Worsens after eating
May accompany belching or poor appetite
Triggered or worsened by emotional or dietary irregularity
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在胃，與肝、脾密切相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Stomach, closely related to the Liver and Spleen.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 實痞消食導滯、疏肝理氣、清熱化濕；虛痞健脾益氣、辛開苦降；寒熱錯雜者辛開苦降並用。
records.treatment_principle_en: Excess-type glomus: reduce food stagnation, soothe the Liver and regulate Qi, clear Heat and transform Dampness. Deficiency-type glomus: strengthen the Spleen and tonify Qi, using pungent-opening/bitter-descending methods. Mixed Cold-Heat: combine pungent-opening and bitter-descending methods.

red_flags_zh.finding: 胸、下顎、頸部或手臂疼痛
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速就醫評估心臟疾病
red_flags_zh.rationale: 上腹部不適可能為心臟疾病的非典型表現

red_flags_zh.finding: 吞嚥困難或吞嚥疼痛
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 轉診腸胃科安排內視鏡檢查
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除食道或胃部器質性病變

red_flags_zh.finding: 眼睛或皮膚發黃
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速就醫檢查肝膽功能
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示肝膽系統病變
red_flags_zh.source: reused from data/pathology/red_flag_registry.json entity cond.functional_dyspepsia (rf.functional_dyspepsia.legacy07), original evidence NIDDK "Symptoms & Causes of Indigestion", retrieved 2026-08-08

red_flags_zh.finding: 黑色柏油樣糞便，或頻繁嘔吐、嘔血

records.definition_zh: 嘔吐是胃失和降、胃氣上逆，迫使胃內容物從口而出的病證，嘔與吐常同時出現，故並稱。
records.definition_en: Ou Tu (Vomiting) is a disease in which the Stomach loses its harmonious descending function and Stomach Qi rebels upward, forcing stomach contents out through the mouth. Retching (Ou) and vomiting (Tu) usually occur together, hence the combined name.
records.etiology_zh: 多因外邪犯胃、飲食不節（暴飲暴食、誤食不潔）、情志不遂肝氣犯胃，或脾胃虛寒、胃陰不足所致。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by an external pathogen attacking the Stomach, dietary irregularity (overeating or ingesting contaminated food), emotional stress with Liver Qi invading the Stomach, or an underlying Spleen-Stomach Cold-vacuity or Stomach Yin insufficiency.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 胃以降為和；外邪、食滯、肝氣或痰飲皆可壅遏胃氣，使胃失和降、上逆而嘔；脾胃陽虛者運化無力，胃陰不足者失於濡潤，皆可致胃氣上逆。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Stomach's normal function depends on downward movement. An external pathogen, food stagnation, Liver Qi, or Phlegm-fluids can all obstruct Stomach Qi so it loses its descending function and rebels upward as vomiting. Spleen-Stomach Yang deficiency weakens transportation, and Stomach Yin insufficiency deprives the Stomach of moistening — both can likewise drive Stomach Qi to rebel.
key_manifestations_zh: 嘔吐（新病多急，久病多緩）
噁心
脘腹脹悶
食入即吐或朝食暮吐
可伴腹瀉或發熱（外邪犯胃者）
key_manifestations_en: Vomiting (acute in new-onset cases, gradual in chronic cases)
Nausea
Epigastric fullness and oppression
Vomiting immediately after eating, or delayed vomiting
May accompany diarrhea or fever when an external pathogen is involved
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在胃，與肝、脾關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Stomach, closely related to the Liver and Spleen.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以和胃降逆止嘔為總則：外邪犯胃者疏邪解表、和中止嘔，食滯者消食化滯，肝氣犯胃者疏肝和胃，脾胃虛寒者溫中健脾，胃陰不足者滋陰養胃。
records.treatment_principle_en: The overall principle is to harmonize the Stomach, redirect rebellious Qi downward, and stop vomiting: for an external pathogen, disperse the pathogen and harmonize the Middle; for food stagnation, disperse food and resolve stagnation; for Liver Qi invading the Stomach, soothe the Liver and harmonize the Stomach; for Spleen-Stomach Yang deficiency, warm the Middle and fortify the Spleen; for Stomach Yin insufficiency, nourish Yin and the Stomach.

red_flags_zh.finding: 劇烈腹痛或出現脫水徵兆（口乾、尿少、頭暈）
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除急腹症或評估脫水嚴重度

red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests upper gastrointestinal bleeding

red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out meningitis or raised intracranial pressure

red_flags_en.finding: Severe abdominal pain or signs of dehydration

records.definition_zh: 吞酸是以酸水上泛，甚則酸水刺喉、口中泛酸為主要表現的病證，多因肝胃不和、胃失和降，或脾胃虛寒、濕濁上泛所致。
records.definition_en: Tun Suan (Acid Regurgitation) is characterized by acid fluid rising up, with severe cases irritating the throat and a sour taste in the mouth, usually due to Liver-Stomach disharmony with Stomach failing to descend, or Spleen-Stomach Cold-deficiency with turbid Dampness rising.
records.etiology_zh: 情志不遂，肝氣犯胃，肝胃鬱熱；或飲食不節，脾胃損傷，寒濕內生，濁氣上逆。
records.etiology_en: Emotional frustration causes Liver Qi to invade the Stomach, producing Liver-Stomach depressive Heat; or dietary irregularity injures the Spleen-Stomach, generating internal Cold-Damp with turbid Qi rebelling upward.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肝鬱化熱，橫逆犯胃，胃失和降，胃氣挾酸上逆則吞酸嘈雜；脾胃虛寒者運化失司，濕濁內停，隨胃氣上泛則泛吐清水酸水。
records.pathomechanism_en: Liver depression transforms into Heat and invades the Stomach transversely; the Stomach loses its harmonious descent, and Stomach Qi carrying acid rebels upward, producing acid regurgitation and gnawing hunger sensation. In Spleen-Stomach Cold-deficiency, transportation fails, internal Damp-turbidity accumulates, and rises with Stomach Qi to produce watery, sour regurgitation.
key_manifestations_zh: 泛酸，或嘈雜似饑
胸骨後或胃脘部灼熱感
噯氣、噁心
夜臥或飽食後加重
可伴胸悶脅痛
key_manifestations_en: Acid regurgitation, or gnawing hunger-like sensation
Retrosternal or epigastric burning sensation
Belching and nausea
Worsens lying down at night or after a full meal
May accompany chest oppression and rib-side pain
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在胃，與肝、脾相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Stomach, related to the Liver and Spleen.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 肝胃鬱熱者疏肝泄熱、和胃降逆；脾胃虛寒者溫中健脾、和胃制酸。
records.treatment_principle_en: Liver-Stomach depressive Heat: soothe the Liver and drain Heat, harmonize the Stomach and downbear rebellious Qi. Spleen-Stomach Cold-deficiency: warm the middle and strengthen the Spleen, harmonize the Stomach and restrain acid.

red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 轉診腸胃科安排內視鏡檢查
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除食道狹窄、食道炎或惡性病變

records.definition_zh: 呃逆是以氣逆上衝，喉間呃呃連聲，聲短而頻，不能自止為主要表現的病證，多因胃氣上逆動膈所致。
records.definition_en: E Ni (Hiccup) is characterized by Qi rebelling upward with short, frequent hiccupping sounds in the throat that cannot be controlled, usually due to Stomach Qi rebelling upward and disturbing the diaphragm.
records.etiology_zh: 飲食不節（過食生冷、辛熱）、情志不遂、正氣虧虛、久病體弱，皆可致胃失和降，氣逆動膈。
records.etiology_en: Dietary irregularity (excess raw-cold or spicy-hot food), emotional frustration, upright Qi deficiency, or chronic debility can all cause the Stomach to lose its harmonious descent, with Qi rebelling to disturb the diaphragm.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 胃居膈下，胃氣以降為順；凡寒邪、熱邪、氣鬱、痰阻或正虛，皆可致胃氣上逆，挾膈間之氣上衝喉間而發呃逆；久病重病見呃逆不止者，多屬胃氣將絕之危候。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Stomach sits below the diaphragm and its Qi normally descends. Cold, Heat, Qi depression, Phlegm obstruction, or upright-Qi deficiency can all cause Stomach Qi to rebel upward, carrying diaphragmatic Qi up to the throat and producing hiccup. In severe chronic illness, unrelenting hiccup is often a critical sign that Stomach Qi is about to be exhausted.
key_manifestations_zh: 喉間呃呃連聲，聲短而頻
不能自主控制
可因飲食、情緒或受寒誘發
輕者偶發自止，重者晝夜不停
key_manifestations_en: Short, frequent hiccupping sounds in the throat
Cannot be voluntarily controlled
May be triggered by diet, emotion, or cold exposure
Mild cases self-resolve; severe cases persist day and night
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在膈，病變關鍵臟腑為胃，與肝、腎相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the diaphragm, with the Stomach as the key organ, related to the Liver and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 治療總以和胃降逆為原則，實證分辨寒熱氣鬱而治，虛證分辨陰陽兩虛而補，危重病中出現呃逆不止者尤需重視。
records.treatment_principle_en: Overall treatment harmonizes the Stomach and downbears rebellious Qi; excess patterns are treated according to Cold, Heat, or Qi depression, deficiency patterns according to Yin or Yang deficiency. Unrelenting hiccup in critically ill patients warrants particular clinical attention.

red_flags_zh.finding: 呃逆持續超過48小時，或反覆發作成為慢性呃逆
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速就醫檢查潛在病因
red_flags_zh.rationale: 持續呃逆可能提示神經系統疾病、代謝異常、胸腹腔疾病或惡性腫瘤等器質性病因

red_flags_zh.finding: 慢性呃逆影響睡眠、進食、飲水或說話
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示需醫療介入處理

red_flags_en.finding: Hiccups lasting longer than 48 hours, or chronic recurrent hiccups
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek prompt medical evaluation for underlying cause
red_flags_en.rationale: Persistent hiccups may indicate a nervous system disorder, metabolic imbalance, thoracic/abdominal disease, or malignancy

red_flags_en.finding: Chronic hiccups interfering with sleep, eating, drinking, or talking
red_flags_en.rationale: Indicates need for medical intervention

records.definition_zh: 泄瀉是以大便次數增多、糞質稀溏甚則如水樣為主症的病證，古人以大便溏薄勢緩者為泄、暴注下迫者為瀉，現多合稱。
records.definition_en: Xie Xie (Diarrhea) is a disease characterized by increased stool frequency with loose or watery stools. Classically, gradual loose stools were called Xie and sudden forceful watery discharge was called Xie (瀉); the two are now usually combined under one name.
records.etiology_zh: 多因感受外邪（寒濕、濕熱）、飲食不節或不潔、情志失調（肝氣乘脾），或脾胃虛弱、命門火衰（腎陽虛）所致。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by external pathogens (Cold-Damp or Damp-Heat), dietary irregularity or contaminated food, emotional disturbance (Liver Qi overacting on the Spleen), or an underlying Spleen-Stomach weakness or Kidney Yang (Gate of Vitality Fire) deficiency.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 脾主運化、喜燥惡濕；濕邪困脾、食滯腸胃或肝木乘土，皆令脾失健運、水穀不化、清濁不分而下趨大腸作瀉；久瀉傷及脾腎陽氣，則轉為虛寒久瀉。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Spleen governs transportation and transformation and prefers dryness over dampness. Whether Dampness encumbers the Spleen, food stagnates in the intestines, or the Liver (Wood) overacts on the Spleen (Earth), the Spleen loses its transporting function, food and fluids go untransformed, clear and turbid fail to separate, and the mixture pours down into the large intestine as diarrhea. Chronic diarrhea injures Spleen-Kidney Yang, shifting the pattern to a chronic Cold-vacuity type.
key_manifestations_zh: 大便次數增多、質稀或如水樣
腹痛腸鳴
可伴脘腹脹悶、食慾不振
情緒緊張時發作或加重（肝鬱乘脾者）
久瀉者黎明前腹瀉（五更瀉，腎陽虛）
key_manifestations_en: Increased stool frequency, loose or watery
Abdominal pain with borborygmus
May accompany epigastric fullness and poor appetite
Triggered or worsened by emotional stress (Liver-Spleen disharmony)
Pre-dawn diarrhea in chronic cases ("fifth-watch diarrhea," Kidney Yang deficiency)
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在脾胃、大小腸，與肝、腎相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Spleen-Stomach and intestines, related to the Liver and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以運脾化濕為總則：寒濕者溫化寒濕，濕熱者清熱利濕，食滯者消食導滯，肝鬱乘脾者抑肝扶脾，脾腎陽虛者溫補脾腎、固澀止瀉。
records.treatment_principle_en: The overall principle is to fortify Spleen transportation and resolve Dampness: for Cold-Damp, warm and transform it; for Damp-Heat, clear Heat and disinhibit Dampness; for food stagnation, disperse food and guide out stagnation; for Liver-Spleen disharmony, restrain the Liver and support the Spleen; for Spleen-Kidney Yang deficiency, warmly tonify Spleen and Kidney with astringing formulas.

red_flags_zh.finding: 黑便（瀝青便）、便中帶鮮血或膿液
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示消化道出血或發炎性腸道疾病
red_flags_zh.source: reused from data/pathology/red_flag_registry.json entity cond.chronic_diarrhea / cond.ibs (rf.chronic_diarrhea.bloody_pus_tarry_stools, rf.ibs.rectal_bleeding_bloody_stools)

red_flags_zh.finding: 出現脫水症狀（口乾、尿少、頭暈、心悸）
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速就醫評估，必要時補液
red_flags_zh.rationale: 嚴重腹瀉合併脫水可致電解質失衡

red_flags_zh.finding: 嚴重或大量直腸出血
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即急診，可能需緊急手術
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示發炎性腸道疾病急性重症發作

red_flags_zh.finding: 貧血或不明原因體重減輕
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除大腸腫瘤或發炎性腸道疾病

red_flags_en.finding: Black tarry stools, or stools containing red blood or pus
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests gastrointestinal bleeding or inflammatory bowel disease
red_flags_en.source: reused from data/pathology/red_flag_registry.json entity cond.chronic_diarrhea / cond.ibs (rf.chronic_diarrhea.bloody_pus_tarry_stools, rf.ibs.rectal_bleeding_bloody_stools)

red_flags_en.finding: Signs of dehydration (dry mouth, low urine output, dizziness, palpitations)
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Prompt evaluation and rehydration if needed
red_flags_en.rationale: Severe diarrhea with dehydration can cause electrolyte imbalance

red_flags_en.finding: Severe or heavy rectal bleeding
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Immediate emergency care, may require emergency surgery
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests a severe acute flare of inflammatory bowel disease

red_flags_en.finding: Anemia or unexplained weight loss
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out colorectal tumor or inflammatory bowel disease

records.definition_zh: 便秘是以大便秘結不通、排便間隔延長，或糞質乾硬、排出艱難為主症的病證。
records.definition_en: Bian Mi (Constipation) is a disease characterized by infrequent, difficult, or incomplete bowel movements with hard, dry stool.
records.etiology_zh: 多因飲食不節（辛熱厚味、飲水過少）、情志不遂（肝鬱氣滯）、年老體虛（氣血陰陽不足）或久坐少動所致。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by dietary factors (excessive spicy/rich food, insufficient fluid intake), emotional disturbance (Liver Qi stagnation), advancing age with underlying vacuity (Qi, Blood, Yin, or Yang deficiency), or a sedentary lifestyle.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 大腸主傳導，以通為用；燥熱內結、氣機鬱滯，皆令大腸傳導失司、糟粕內停而秘結；氣血陰陽虧虛者，則腸道失於濡潤或推動無力，亦致大便艱澀。
records.pathomechanism_en: The large intestine governs conveyance and functions best when unobstructed. Internal Dryness-Heat binding or Qi stagnation both impair the large intestine's conveying function, causing waste to accumulate and stools to bind. In Qi, Blood, Yin, or Yang deficiency, the intestines lack moistening or propulsive force, likewise producing difficult defecation.
key_manifestations_zh: 大便秘結、排便間隔延長
糞質乾硬難下
腹脹或腹部隱痛
排便費力、便後仍覺不盡
可伴口臭、面色無華（虛證）
key_manifestations_en: Infrequent, bound bowel movements
Hard, dry stool that is difficult to pass
Abdominal distension or dull discomfort
Straining with a sense of incomplete evacuation
May accompany bad breath or a sallow complexion in vacuity patterns
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在大腸，與脾、胃、肺、肝、腎相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the large intestine, related to the Spleen, Stomach, Lung, Liver, and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以通下為法，隨證而異：熱秘者瀉熱通便，氣秘者順氣導滯，氣虛者益氣潤腸，血虛陰虧者養血滋陰潤腸，陽虛者溫陽通便，切忌一味攻下傷正。
records.treatment_principle_en: The overall principle is to unblock the bowel, adapted to the pattern: for Heat constipation, drain Heat to free the stool; for Qi constipation, regulate Qi to resolve stagnation; for Qi deficiency, boost Qi to moisten the intestines; for Blood/Yin deficiency, nourish Blood and Yin to moisten the intestines; for Yang deficiency, warm Yang to unblock the bowel — avoiding indiscriminate purgation that would injure the correct Qi.

red_flags_zh.finding: 無法排氣、嘔吐或發燒
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除腸阻塞

red_flags_zh.finding: 便中帶血、黑便，或不明原因體重減輕
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除大腸腫瘤或消化道出血，尤其新發於中老年者

red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out bowel obstruction

red_flags_en.finding: Blood in the stool, black stools, or unexplained weight loss
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out colorectal tumor or GI bleeding, especially with new onset in middle-aged/older adults

records.definition_zh: 腹痛是以胃脘以下、恥骨毛際以上部位發生疼痛為主要表現的病證，病因廣泛，可涉及多個臟腑及氣血津液病變。
records.definition_en: Fu Tong (Abdominal Pain) is characterized by pain located below the epigastrium and above the pubic hairline; its causes are broad and may involve multiple organs and Qi-Blood-Fluid pathology.
records.etiology_zh: 外感寒邪、飲食不節、情志失調、蟲積內停、瘀血阻滯，或臟腑虛寒、氣血不足，皆可致腹部經脈氣血運行不暢。
records.etiology_en: External Cold invasion, dietary irregularity, emotional disturbance, internal parasite accumulation, Blood stasis obstruction, or organ Cold-deficiency and Qi-Blood insufficiency can all impede the free flow of Qi and Blood in the abdominal channels.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 腹部為足三陰、足少陽、陽明、任脈及沖脈循行之處，凡邪氣壅滯、氣血運行不暢，「不通則痛」；或臟腑虛寒、氣血虧虛，經脈失於溫養，「不榮則痛」。
records.pathomechanism_en: The abdomen is traversed by the three Foot Yin channels, Foot Shaoyang, Yangming, the Conception Vessel, and the Penetrating Vessel. Pathogenic Qi stagnation obstructing free flow produces "pain due to obstruction"; organ Cold-deficiency and Qi-Blood insufficiency depriving the channels of warmth and nourishment produces "pain due to malnourishment."
key_manifestations_zh: 腹部疼痛，性質可為脹痛、絞痛、刺痛或隱痛
疼痛部位可固定或遊走
可伴腹脹、腸鳴、便秘或泄瀉
遇寒、飲食或情緒誘發加重
key_manifestations_en: Abdominal pain, which may be distending, cramping, stabbing, or dull
Pain location may be fixed or migratory
May accompany abdominal distension, borborygmus, constipation, or diarrhea
Triggered or worsened by cold, diet, or emotion
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在腹，涉及脾、胃、肝、膽、腸等臟腑。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the abdomen, involving the Spleen, Stomach, Liver, Gallbladder, and Intestines.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 實證以「通」為法，分寒熱虛實，消食導滯、行氣活血、清熱化濕；虛證以溫中補虛、緩急止痛為主，虛中夾實者當攻補兼施。
records.treatment_principle_en: Excess patterns follow the principle of "unblocking," differentiated by Cold/Heat/deficiency/excess: reduce food stagnation, move Qi and Blood, clear Heat and transform Dampness. Deficiency patterns focus on warming the middle, tonifying deficiency, and relieving spasm to stop pain; mixed deficiency-excess presentations require both attack and tonification.

red_flags_zh.finding: 右下腹疼痛，呈突發性且進行性加劇，伴噁心、發燒或壓痛
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即送急診，不要自行開車前往
red_flags_zh.rationale: 典型闌尾炎表現，延誤治療可能導致穿孔、腹膜炎、敗血症；風險隨發病48小時後上升

red_flags_zh.finding: 身體任何部位突發劇烈疼痛
red_flags_zh.rationale: 屬於一般急症警訊

red_flags_en.finding: Lower right abdominal pain, sudden onset and progressively worsening, with nausea, fever, or tenderness
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Go to the emergency department immediately; do not drive yourself
red_flags_en.rationale: Classic presentation of appendicitis; delayed treatment risks rupture, peritonitis, and sepsis, with risk rising after 48 hours

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden, severe pain anywhere in the body
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call 911 or go to the emergency department immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: General emergency warning sign

records.definition_zh: 脅痛是以一側或兩側脅肋部疼痛為主要表現的病證，病位主要在肝膽，與情志、飲食關係密切。
records.definition_en: Xie Tong (Hypochondriac Pain) is characterized by pain in one or both rib-side (hypochondriac) regions; the disease location is mainly the Liver and Gallbladder, closely related to emotion and diet.
records.etiology_zh: 情志不遂，肝氣鬱結；飲食不節，濕熱蘊結肝膽；跌僕閃挫，瘀血停著；或久病體虛，肝陰不足，脈絡失養。
records.etiology_en: Emotional frustration causing Liver Qi stagnation; dietary irregularity generating Damp-Heat accumulation in the Liver and Gallbladder; trauma or sprain causing Blood stasis to lodge; or chronic debility with Liver Yin insufficiency depriving the network vessels of nourishment.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肝主疏泄，喜條達；肝氣鬱結，疏泄失常，氣機阻滯脅絡則脹痛；濕熱蘊結肝膽，氣血壅滯則脅痛拒按；瘀血停滯脅絡，不通則痛，痛有定處；肝陰不足，脈絡失養，則隱痛綿綿。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Liver governs free coursing and favors unimpeded flow. Liver Qi stagnation disrupts this function, obstructing Qi in the rib-side network vessels and causing distending pain. Damp-Heat accumulation in the Liver-Gallbladder congests Qi and Blood, causing pain worse with pressure. Blood stasis lodging in the rib-side vessels causes fixed, unrelenting pain. Liver Yin insufficiency depriving the vessels of nourishment causes a dull, lingering ache.
key_manifestations_zh: 一側或兩側脅肋部脹痛或刺痛
隨情緒波動增減
可伴口苦、噁心、納呆
瘀血者痛處固定拒按
陰虛者痛勢隱隱，伴口乾
key_manifestations_en: Distending or stabbing pain in one or both hypochondriac regions
Fluctuates with emotional state
May accompany bitter taste, nausea, poor appetite
Blood stasis type: fixed pain worse with pressure
Yin deficiency type: dull lingering pain with dry mouth
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在肝膽，與脾胃相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Liver and Gallbladder, related to the Spleen and Stomach.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 肝鬱氣滯者疏肝理氣；濕熱蘊結者清熱利濕；瘀血停著者活血化瘀通絡；肝陰不足者滋陰柔肝。
records.treatment_principle_en: Liver Qi stagnation: soothe the Liver and regulate Qi. Damp-Heat accumulation: clear Heat and drain Dampness. Blood stasis lodging: invigorate Blood, dispel stasis, and unblock the network vessels. Liver Yin insufficiency: nourish Yin and soften the Liver.

red_flags_zh.finding: 右上腹劇痛合併發燒、噁心嘔吐或黃疸
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即就醫評估膽囊/膽道疾病
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示急性膽囊炎或膽道感染，可能需緊急處置
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Chronic cholecystitis" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000217.htm — "Contact your provider if you develop symptoms of cholecystitis": upper right abdominal pain, fever, nausea, vomiting, jaundice), retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_zh.finding: 脅痛合併皮膚或眼白發黃
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速就醫檢查肝膽功能
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示膽道阻塞或肝膽系統病變

red_flags_en.finding: Sharp upper right abdominal pain with fever, nausea, vomiting, or jaundice
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek immediate evaluation for gallbladder/biliary disease
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests acute cholecystitis or biliary infection, may require urgent intervention
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus "Chronic cholecystitis" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000217.htm — "Contact your provider if you develop symptoms of cholecystitis"), retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_en.finding: Hypochondriac pain with yellowing of the skin or eyes
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek prompt evaluation of liver and biliary function
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests biliary obstruction or hepatobiliary disease

records.definition_zh: 黃疸是以目黃、身黃、小便黃為主要表現的病證，因濕邪困遏脾胃、膽液不循常道、外溢肌膚所致。
records.definition_en: Huang Dan (Jaundice) is characterized by yellowing of the eyes, body, and urine, caused by Dampness obstructing the Spleen-Stomach so that bile fails to follow its normal pathway and overflows into the skin.
records.etiology_zh: 外感濕熱疫毒，或飲食不節，酒食內傷，或脾胃虛寒，運化失司，均可使濕邪內生，壅遏中焦，膽汁失於疏泄。
records.etiology_en: External contraction of Damp-Heat epidemic toxin, or dietary irregularity with alcohol/food injury, or Spleen-Stomach Cold-deficiency with failed transportation, can all generate internal Dampness that obstructs the middle burner and impairs bile's free flow.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 濕邪為病機關鍵，濕熱蘊結中焦，熏蒸肝膽，膽汁不循常道，外溢肌膚則發為陽黃；寒濕困脾，脾陽不振，膽汁為陰寒所凝，溢於肌膚則發為陰黃；黃疸日久不退，或反覆發作，可致積聚、鼓脹。
records.pathomechanism_en: Dampness is the pathomechanistic key. Damp-Heat accumulating in the middle burner steams the Liver-Gallbladder, so bile fails its normal course and overflows into the skin, producing Yang Jaundice. Cold-Damp encumbering the Spleen weakens Spleen Yang; bile congealed by Yin-Cold overflows into the skin, producing Yin Jaundice. Jaundice that fails to resolve or recurs may progress to abdominal masses or distension (積聚/鼓脹).
key_manifestations_zh: 目睛黃染，身黃，小便黃赤
陽黃者黃色鮮明如橘皮色，伴發熱口渴、脅痛
陰黃者黃色晦暗如煙熏，伴畏寒肢冷、納呆便溏
可伴皮膚瘙癢
key_manifestations_en: Yellowing of the sclerae, body, and reddish-yellow urine
Yang Jaundice: bright orange-yellow color with fever, thirst, hypochondriac pain
Yin Jaundice: dull, smoky-yellow color with cold intolerance, cold limbs, poor appetite, loose stool
May accompany itchy skin
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在脾、胃、肝、膽。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Spleen, Stomach, Liver, and Gallbladder.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 陽黃清熱利濕、佐以通腑；陰黃溫中化濕、健脾和胃；黃疸消退後仍需調理脾胃、疏肝利膽以防復發。
records.treatment_principle_en: Yang Jaundice: clear Heat and drain Dampness, assisted by freeing the bowels. Yin Jaundice: warm the middle and transform Dampness, strengthen the Spleen and harmonize the Stomach. After jaundice resolves, continue regulating the Spleen-Stomach and soothing the Liver-Gallbladder to prevent recurrence.

red_flags_zh.finding: 出現黃疸
red_flags_zh.rationale: 黃疸本身即為就醫指標，需釐清病因
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Jaundice" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000210.htm — "Contact your provider if you develop jaundice"), retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_zh.finding: 黃疸合併發燒與劇烈上腹/右上腹持續性疼痛
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示急性膽管炎等危及生命的膽道感染
red_flags_zh.source: cross-referenced from MedlinePlus "Chronic cholecystitis" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000217.htm, fever + severe RUQ pain + jaundice triad) and gallbladder-emergency literature synthesis, retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_zh.finding: 大便顏色變淺、尿色深黃合併不明原因體重減輕
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速安排肝膽胰影像學及抽血檢查
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示膽道阻塞或惡性腫瘤（如胰臟癌、膽管癌）可能
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Jaundice" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000210.htm, symptom description: dark urine, pale/clay-colored stools) cross-referenced with MedlinePlus "Weight loss - unintentional" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003107.htm), retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_en.finding: Development of jaundice
red_flags_en.rationale: Jaundice itself is an indication to seek care and clarify the underlying cause
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus "Jaundice" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000210.htm — "Contact your provider if you develop jaundice"), retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_en.finding: Jaundice with fever and severe, persistent upper/right-upper abdominal pain
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call 911 / go to the emergency department immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests acute cholangitis, a life-threatening biliary infection
red_flags_en.source: cross-referenced from MedlinePlus "Chronic cholecystitis" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000217.htm, fever + severe RUQ pain + jaundice triad) and gallbladder-emergency literature synthesis, retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_en.finding: Pale stools and dark urine with unexplained weight loss
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Arrange prompt hepatobiliary/pancreatic imaging and blood work
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests biliary obstruction or possible malignancy (e.g. pancreatic or bile-duct cancer)
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus "Jaundice" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000210.htm) cross-referenced with MedlinePlus "Weight loss - unintentional" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003107.htm), retrieved 2026-08-11

records.definition_zh: 痔瘡是以肛門直腸末端靜脈叢曲張、腫脹，或伴出血、脫出、疼痛為主要表現的肛腸病證，多因臟腑本虛、大腸氣血運行不暢，兼濕熱下注、風燥傷絡所致。
records.definition_en: Zhi Chuang (Hemorrhoids) is an anorectal disease characterized by varicose, swollen venous plexuses at the anorectal junction, with possible bleeding, prolapse, or pain, usually due to underlying organ deficiency and poor Qi-Blood flow in the Large Intestine, compounded by Damp-Heat pouring downward or Wind-Dryness injuring the vessels.
records.etiology_zh: 飲食不節，嗜食辛辣厚味，濕熱內生；久坐久立、久瀉久痢或妊娠，致氣血運行不暢；素體虛弱，中氣下陷，脈絡鬆弛。
records.etiology_en: Dietary irregularity with excess spicy, rich food generating internal Damp-Heat; prolonged sitting/standing, chronic diarrhea/dysentery, or pregnancy impeding Qi-Blood flow; or constitutional weakness with Center Qi sinking and lax vessels.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 濕熱下注大腸，壅滯肛門，脈絡損傷，血不循經則便血；氣血瘀滯，脈絡曲張隆起則成痔核；中氣下陷者肛門失於固攝，則痔核脫出。
records.pathomechanism_en: Damp-Heat pouring down into the Large Intestine congests the anus and injures the vessels, causing Blood to leave its pathway and produce bleeding stool. Qi-Blood stagnation causes the vessels to distend and bulge into hemorrhoidal masses. Center Qi sinking leaves the anus unable to hold, causing the hemorrhoidal mass to prolapse.
key_manifestations_zh: 便血，色鮮紅，或滴血、噴射狀出血
肛門腫物脫出，便後可自行回納或需用手托回
肛門墜脹、疼痛或瘙癢
久病氣虛者痔核脫出不能回納
key_manifestations_en: Bloody stool, bright red, dripping or spurting
Prolapsed anal mass, self-reducing or requiring manual reduction after defecation
Anal heaviness, pain, or itching
Chronic Qi-deficient cases: irreducible prolapse
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在肛門直腸，與大腸、脾相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the anorectum, related to the Large Intestine and Spleen.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 濕熱下注者清熱利濕、涼血止血；氣虛下陷者補中益氣、昇陽固脫；久病血瘀者兼以活血化瘀。
records.treatment_principle_en: Damp-Heat pouring down: clear Heat and drain Dampness, cool the Blood and stop bleeding. Qi deficiency with sinking: tonify the Center and boost Qi, raise Yang and secure prolapse. Chronic Blood stasis cases: combine with invigorating Blood and dispelling stasis.

red_flags_zh.finding: 劇烈肛門痛與直腸出血，特別是伴隨腹部不適、腹瀉或發燒
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除肛周膿瘍、嵌頓痔或其他急性肛門直腸病變

red_flags_zh.finding: 即使認為是痔瘡引起的血便，仍應就醫檢查

records.definition_zh: 頭痛是以頭部疼痛為主要表現的病證，病因複雜，可單獨出現，亦可見於多種急慢性疾病過程中，須先鑑別是否為外感或內傷所致。
records.definition_en: Tou Tong (Headache) is a disease characterized primarily by head pain. Its causes are complex; it may occur alone or as part of many acute and chronic illnesses, and must first be differentiated as external-contraction or internal-damage in origin.
records.etiology_zh: 外感頭痛多因風邪夾寒、熱、濕侵襲；內傷頭痛多因肝陽上亢、肝火上炎、痰濁上蒙、瘀血阻絡，或氣血虧虛、腎精不足、清竅失養所致。
records.etiology_en: External-contraction headache is usually caused by Wind combined with Cold, Heat, or Dampness invading upward. Internal-damage headache is usually caused by Liver Yang rising, Liver Fire flaring upward, Phlegm-turbidity clouding the head, Blood stasis obstructing the network vessels, or Qi-Blood/Kidney Essence deficiency failing to nourish the clear orifices.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 頭為諸陽之會、清竅所在，凡外邪上擾清竅，或內傷病理產物（風、火、痰、瘀）循經上犯，或精血不足不能上榮，皆可致頭部脈絡失和而痛。
records.pathomechanism_en: The head is where all the Yang channels converge and houses the clear orifices. Whether an external pathogen disturbs the clear orifices from above, or an internal pathological product (Wind, Fire, Phlegm, or stasis) travels upward along the channels, or Essence and Blood are insufficient to nourish the head, the network vessels of the head lose their harmony and pain results.
key_manifestations_zh: 頭部脹痛、跳痛或刺痛
疼痛部位固定或遊走
隨情緒、月經、疲勞誘發或加重
可伴頭暈、目脹
反覆發作
key_manifestations_en: Distending, throbbing, or stabbing head pain
Fixed or migratory pain location
Triggered or worsened by emotion, menstruation, or fatigue
May accompany dizziness or eye distension
Recurrent episodes
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在頭，與肝、脾、腎關係密切；久痛入絡者及血瘀。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the head, closely related to the Liver, Spleen, and Kidney; chronic pain that enters the network vessels involves Blood stasis.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 外感頭痛以疏風為主，隨寒熱濕邪加減；內傷頭痛當平肝潛陽、清肝瀉火、化痰、活血通絡或補益氣血腎精，隨證而治。
records.treatment_principle_en: External-contraction headache is treated mainly by dispersing Wind, modified for accompanying Cold, Heat, or Dampness. Internal-damage headache requires calming the Liver and subduing Yang, clearing Liver Fire, transforming Phlegm, invigorating Blood to unblock the network vessels, or tonifying Qi-Blood and Kidney Essence, according to the pattern.

red_flags_zh.finding: 霹靂性頭痛（數秒至數分鐘內達最劇烈程度）
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即急診，排除蛛網膜下腔出血
red_flags_zh.rationale: 典型蛛網膜下腔出血或其他顱內出血表現

red_flags_zh.finding: 發燒合併頸部僵硬、畏光
red_flags_zh.rationale: 腦膜炎典型三聯徵之一

red_flags_zh.finding: 50歲以上新發頭痛、漸進性惡化、伴神經缺損或晨間嘔吐
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除顱內腫瘤或顱內壓升高

red_flags_en.finding: Thunderclap headache (reaching maximal intensity within seconds to minutes)
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Immediate emergency evaluation to rule out subarachnoid hemorrhage
red_flags_en.rationale: Classic presentation of SAH or other intracranial hemorrhage
red_flags_en.source: reused from data/pathology/red_flag_registry.json entity cond.migraine / cond.tension_headache (rf.migraine.legacy01, rf.tension_headache.legacy01)

red_flags_en.finding: Fever with neck stiffness and photophobia
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Immediate emergency evaluation to rule out meningitis

red_flags_en.finding: New headache onset over age 50, progressively worsening, with focal deficit or morning vomiting
red_flags_en.rationale: Must exclude intracranial tumor or raised intracranial pressure

records.definition_zh: 眩暈是以頭暈目眩、視物旋轉或站立不穩為主要表現的病證，輕者閉目可止，重者如坐舟車，甚則暈仆。
records.definition_en: Xuan Yun (Dizziness) is a disease characterized by dizziness, blurred or spinning vision, or unsteadiness. Mild cases resolve on closing the eyes; severe cases feel like being on a boat or vehicle, and the most severe may cause collapse.
records.etiology_zh: 多因情志不遂、肝陽偏亢；或飲食不節、脾失健運、痰濕內生；或久病體虛、氣血不足；或年老腎虧、精髓不充所致。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by emotional stress leading to Liver Yang hyperactivity; or an improper diet impairing Spleen transportation and generating internal Phlegm-Dampness; or chronic illness with Qi-Blood deficiency; or aging with Kidney depletion and insufficient Marrow.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肝陽上亢、肝風內動,擾動清空;或痰濕中阻,清陽不升;或氣血虧虛,清竅失養;或腎精不足,髓海空虛,皆可發為眩暈。
records.pathomechanism_en: Whether from Liver Yang rising and Liver Wind stirring internally to disturb the clear space of the head, Phlegm-Dampness obstructing the Middle so clear Yang fails to ascend, Qi-Blood deficiency failing to nourish the clear orifices, or Kidney Essence deficiency leaving the Sea of Marrow empty — any of these mechanisms can produce dizziness.
key_manifestations_zh: 頭暈目眩
視物旋轉或天旋地轉感
站立不穩
可伴噁心嘔吐
勞累或情緒波動誘發加重
key_manifestations_en: Dizziness with blurred vision
Sensation of spinning or the room spinning
Unsteadiness on standing
May accompany nausea and vomiting
Triggered or worsened by exertion or emotional upset
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在清竅（頭），與肝、脾、腎關係最為密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the clear orifices (head), most closely related to the Liver, Spleen, and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 肝陽上亢者平肝潛陽；痰濕中阻者化痰祛濕、健脾和胃；氣血虧虛者補益氣血；腎精不足者補腎填精。
records.treatment_principle_en: For Liver Yang rising, calm the Liver and subdue Yang; for Phlegm-Dampness obstructing the Middle, transform Phlegm and resolve Dampness while fortifying the Spleen and harmonizing the Stomach; for Qi-Blood deficiency, tonify Qi and Blood; for Kidney Essence deficiency, tonify the Kidney and replenish Essence.

red_flags_zh.finding: 伴隨肢體無力、無法移動手臂或腿部、視力或言語改變
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即急診，撥打當地緊急號碼
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示中風或TIA，屬醫療急症

red_flags_zh.finding: 眩暈伴隨昏厥或警覺性喪失
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能提示嚴重心律不整或中樞神經系統病變

red_flags_zh.finding: 突發步態不穩、失去平衡或協調障礙
red_flags_zh.rationale: 小腦或腦幹中風的典型表現

red_flags_zh.finding: 伴隨突發性聽力喪失（突發性耳聾）
red_flags_zh.rationale: 屬醫療急症，需儘速排查內耳血管或神經病變

red_flags_en.finding: Accompanied by weakness, inability to move an arm or leg, or a change in vision or speech
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests stroke or TIA, a medical emergency

red_flags_en.finding: Vertigo with fainting or loss of alertness
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate serious arrhythmia or central nervous system pathology

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden trouble walking, loss of balance, or lack of coordination
red_flags_en.rationale: Classic presentation of cerebellar or brainstem stroke

red_flags_en.finding: Accompanied by sudden sensorineural hearing loss
red_flags_en.rationale: A medical emergency requiring prompt work-up of inner-ear vascular or neural pathology

records.definition_zh: 中風是以突然昏仆、不省人事，伴口眼喎斜、半身不遂、言語謇澀，或不經昏仆僅見半身不遂等為主要表現的病證，起病急驟，變化迅速，與自然界善行數變之風邪特性相似，故名中風。
records.definition_en: Zhong Feng (Wind-Stroke Disease) is characterized by sudden collapse with loss of consciousness, deviation of the eyes and mouth, hemiplegia, and slurred speech — or hemiplegia without collapse. Onset is abrupt and the course changes rapidly, resembling the mobile, changeable nature of Wind, hence the name.
records.etiology_zh: 多因平素肝腎陰虛、氣血衰少，加以憂思惱怒、飲食不節、勞逸失度或氣候驟變誘發，以致氣血逆亂，直沖犯腦。
records.etiology_en: Usually arises in those with an underlying Liver-Kidney Yin deficiency and Qi-Blood decline, precipitated by worry, anger, dietary irregularity, over-exertion or excessive rest, or sudden weather change, causing Qi and Blood to rebel chaotically upward and rush directly into the brain.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肝腎陰虛則肝陽偏亢,陽亢化風,風火相煽,夾痰夾瘀,上蒙清竅、竄擾經絡,發為中風;病位深淺分中經絡（無神志改變）與中臟腑（神昏），中臟腑又分閉證、脫證。
records.pathomechanism_en: Liver-Kidney Yin deficiency allows Liver Yang to become hyperactive; hyperactive Yang transforms into Wind, Wind and Fire fan each other, and combined with Phlegm and stasis they cloud the clear orifices above and disrupt the channels — producing stroke. By depth, this is classified as channel-network involvement (no altered consciousness) versus organ involvement (coma), the latter further divided into closed (excess, blockage) and desertion (collapse, deficiency) patterns.
key_manifestations_zh: 突然半身不遂
口眼喎斜
言語謇澀或不能言
神志不清（重症）
偏身麻木或感覺異常
key_manifestations_en: Sudden hemiplegia (weakness on one side)
Deviation of the eyes and mouth
Slurred speech or inability to speak
Altered consciousness (severe cases)
Numbness or abnormal sensation on one side of the body
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在腦，與心、肝、腎、脾密切相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the brain, closely related to the Heart, Liver, Kidney, and Spleen.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 急性期以醒神開竅、平肝熄風、化痰通腑或活血通絡為主，閉證開竅、脫證固脫；恢復期著重益氣活血、滋補肝腎。中風為急症，中醫治療須在完成西醫急性期評估與處置後配合介入，不可延誤送醫。
records.treatment_principle_en: In the acute phase, treatment focuses on reviving consciousness and opening the orifices, calming the Liver and extinguishing Wind, transforming Phlegm and freeing the bowels, or invigorating Blood to unblock the network vessels — opening the orifices in closed patterns, securing collapse in desertion patterns. In the recovery phase, the focus shifts to boosting Qi, invigorating Blood, and nourishing the Liver and Kidney. Stroke is a medical emergency; TCM treatment must follow, not delay, emergency biomedical assessment and treatment.

red_flags_zh.finding: 突發臉部下垂、單側手臂無力或無法舉起、言語不清或說話困難（FAST徵象）
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即撥打119，記錄症狀開始時間，儘速送醫
red_flags_zh.rationale: 中風的典型警訊，時間就是腦組織（time is brain），越早送醫治療效果越好

red_flags_zh.finding: 出現新發或復發之中風症狀
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示復發性中風，需即刻評估

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden facial droop, one-sided arm weakness or inability to raise it, or slurred/difficult speech (FAST signs)
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call 911 immediately, note the time symptoms started, and get to a hospital as fast as possible
red_flags_en.rationale: Classic stroke warning signs — "time is brain," earlier treatment gives better outcomes

red_flags_en.finding: New or recurrent signs of stroke
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call 911 or seek emergency care immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests a recurrent stroke requiring immediate evaluation

records.definition_zh: 面癱是以突然口眼歪斜、患側額紋消失、眼瞼閉合不全為主症的病證，多因正氣不足，脈絡空虛，風邪乘虛入中面部經絡所致。
records.definition_en: Facial Paralysis (面癱) is characterized by sudden deviation of the mouth and eyes, loss of forehead wrinkles, and incomplete eyelid closure on the affected side, most often arising when Wind exploits a deficiency of Righteous Qi and an empty channel network to invade the facial channels.
records.etiology_zh: 素體正氣不足，脈絡空虛，起居不慎，風寒或風熱之邪乘虛侵襲面部陽明、少陽經絡；或情志不遂、勞倦內傷，氣血運行不暢，筋脈失養。
records.etiology_en: Underlying deficiency of Righteous Qi leaves the channel network empty; careless exposure allows Wind-Cold or Wind-Heat to invade the Yangming and Shaoyang channels of the face while defenses are weak. Emotional strain or overwork may also impair the flow of Qi and Blood, depriving the sinews of nourishment.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 風邪夾寒或夾熱侵襲頭面經絡，經氣阻滯，氣血痹阻，筋肉失於濡養，縱緩不收，發為口眼歪斜；病程日久，氣虛血瘀，脈絡瘀阻，則恢復遲緩或留有後遺症。
records.pathomechanism_en: Wind, combined with Cold or Heat, invades the channels of the head and face, obstructing channel Qi and impeding the flow of Qi and Blood; the sinews and muscles lose their nourishment, become slack, and fail to contract, producing the deviated mouth and eyes. In protracted cases, Qi deficiency and Blood stasis obstruct the channels further, slowing recovery or leaving sequelae.
key_manifestations_zh: 突然一側口眼歪斜
患側額紋消失、不能皺眉
患側眼瞼閉合不全，露睛流淚
患側鼻唇溝變淺，鼓腮漏氣
部分患者初起耳後或面部輕微疼痛
key_manifestations_en: Sudden deviation of the mouth and eye on one side
Loss of forehead wrinkles and inability to raise the eyebrow on the affected side
Incomplete eyelid closure with exposed sclera and tearing
Flattened nasolabial fold and air leakage when puffing out the cheek
Mild pain behind the ear or on the face at onset in some patients
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在頭面經絡，主要涉及手足陽明、手足少陽經筋。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the channels of the head and face, primarily involving the sinew channels of the Hand/Foot Yangming and Hand/Foot Shaoyang.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 早期以祛風通絡為主，風寒者兼溫經散寒，風熱者兼疏風清熱；恢復期及後遺症期以益氣養血、活血通絡為法。
records.treatment_principle_en: In the early stage, expel Wind and free the channels — for Wind-Cold, also warm the channels and dispel Cold; for Wind-Heat, also disperse Wind and clear Heat. In the recovery and sequelae stages, tonify Qi, nourish Blood, and invigorate Blood to free the channels.

red_flags_zh.finding: 出現顏面下垂或其他面神經麻痺相關症狀
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需醫療專業評估面神經麻痺病因及嚴重度

red_flags_zh.finding: 新發單側顏面下垂，尤其伴隨言語不清、單側肢體無力
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即撥打急救電話／送急診
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需即刻排除急性中風（FAST 篩檢）

red_flags_en.finding: Facial droop or other symptoms of facial nerve paralysis
red_flags_en.rationale: Facial nerve palsy requires professional assessment of cause and severity

records.definition_zh: 顫證是以頭部或肢體不自主地搖動、顫抖為主要表現的病證，多因年老體虛、肝腎陰虧，虛風內動，或痰熱、瘀血阻滯經絡所致。
records.definition_en: Chan Zheng (Tremor Disease) is characterized by involuntary shaking or trembling of the head or limbs, usually due to age-related debility with Liver-Kidney Yin depletion generating internal deficiency Wind, or Phlegm-Heat/Blood stasis obstructing the channels.
records.etiology_zh: 年老體衰，肝腎陰虛，精血不足；情志過極，肝陽化風；飲食不節，痰濕內生，鬱久化熱動風；久病入絡，瘀血阻滯。
records.etiology_en: Age-related decline with Liver-Kidney Yin deficiency and Essence-Blood insufficiency; extreme emotion transforming Liver Yang into Wind; dietary irregularity generating internal Phlegm-Damp that stagnates and transforms into Heat, stirring Wind; or chronic disease entering the network vessels with Blood stasis obstruction.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肝主筋、腎主骨，肝腎陰虛則精血不能濡養筋脈，虛風內動而見顫抖；痰熱內蘊，擾動肝風，或瘀血阻滯經絡，氣血運行不暢，筋脈失養，均可發為顫證；病程日久，陰損及陽，甚則出現痴呆、僵直等變證。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Liver governs the sinews and the Kidney governs the bones. Liver-Kidney Yin deficiency leaves Essence-Blood unable to nourish the sinews, and internal deficiency Wind stirs to produce trembling. Internal Phlegm-Heat disturbing Liver Wind, or Blood stasis obstructing the network vessels and impeding Qi-Blood flow, can also deprive the sinews of nourishment and produce tremor. With prolonged course, Yin damage extends to Yang, and severe cases may develop dementia or rigidity as transformed patterns.
key_manifestations_zh: 頭部或肢體不自主震顫，靜止時明顯
可伴肢體僵硬、動作遲緩
病久可伴表情呆滯、言語不清
可伴腰膝痠軟、頭暈耳鳴
key_manifestations_en: Involuntary tremor of the head or limbs, prominent at rest
May accompany limb stiffness and slowed movement
Chronic cases: blank facial expression, slurred speech
May accompany sore, weak lower back and knees, dizziness, tinnitus
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在筋脈，與肝、腎、脾相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the sinews, related to the Liver, Kidney, and Spleen.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 虛證滋補肝腎、育陰熄風；痰熱動風者清熱化痰、平肝熄風；瘀血阻絡者活血化瘀、疏通經絡；久病虛實夾雜者當標本兼顧。
records.treatment_principle_en: Deficiency patterns: nourish the Liver and Kidney, cultivate Yin and extinguish Wind. Phlegm-Heat stirring Wind: clear Heat and transform Phlegm, calm the Liver and extinguish Wind. Blood stasis obstructing the vessels: invigorate Blood, dispel stasis, and unblock the channels. Chronic mixed deficiency-excess presentations require treating root and branch together.

records.definition_zh: 不寐是以經常不能獲得正常睡眠為主症的病證，輕者入睡困難或睡而易醒，重者徹夜不眠。
records.definition_en: Bu Mei (Insomnia) is a disease characterized by a persistent inability to obtain normal sleep. Mild cases show difficulty falling asleep or easy waking; severe cases have no sleep at all through the night.
records.etiology_zh: 多因情志不遂（肝鬱化火）、思慮勞倦傷及心脾、稟賦不足或久病心腎不交，或飲食不節、痰熱內擾所致。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by emotional disturbance (Liver constraint transforming into Fire), excessive worry or overwork injuring the Heart and Spleen, constitutional weakness or chronic illness disrupting Heart-Kidney communication, or dietary irregularity with internal Phlegm-Heat disturbance.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 心藏神，神安則寐；心火亢盛、痰熱擾心，或心腎不交、水火失濟，或心脾兩虛、神失所養，皆令心神不安而不寐。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Heart houses the Shen (spirit); when the Shen is settled, sleep follows. Whether from Heart Fire blazing, Phlegm-Heat disturbing the Heart, Heart-Kidney failing to communicate so Water and Fire lose their balance, or Heart-Spleen dual deficiency leaving the Shen unnourished — all these mechanisms unsettle the Heart Shen and produce insomnia.
key_manifestations_zh: 入睡困難
睡而易醒或醒後難再入睡
多夢
晨起精神不振、日間疲倦
可伴心悸、健忘、煩躁
key_manifestations_en: Difficulty falling asleep
Easy waking or difficulty returning to sleep
Excessive dreaming
Poor morning alertness and daytime fatigue
May accompany palpitations, poor memory, or irritability
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在心，與肝、脾、腎關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Heart, closely related to the Liver, Spleen, and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以補虛瀉實、調整陰陽、安神定志為總則：心腎不交者交通心腎，心脾兩虛者補益心脾，肝鬱化火者疏肝瀉火，痰熱擾心者清化痰熱。
records.treatment_principle_en: The overall principle is to supplement vacuity, drain excess, regulate Yin-Yang balance, and calm the Shen: for Heart-Kidney disharmony, restore communication between Heart and Kidney; for Heart-Spleen deficiency, tonify both; for Liver constraint transforming Fire, soothe the Liver and drain Fire; for Phlegm-Heat disturbing the Heart, clear and transform Phlegm-Heat.

red_flags_zh.finding: 出現傷害自己或他人的念頭，或曾計畫、嘗試自傷
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即撥打988自殺與危機專線，或撥打119／前往急診
red_flags_zh.rationale: 失眠常為憂鬱症就醫的首發症狀，須立即篩查自殺風險

red_flags_zh.finding: 失眠已成為持續困擾、影響日間功能
red_flags_zh.rationale: MedlinePlus建議失眠已成為問題時應諮詢醫療人員，並排查憂鬱症等共病

red_flags_en.finding: Thoughts of harming self or others, or a plan or attempt to self-harm
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) immediately, or call 911 / go to the emergency room
red_flags_en.rationale: Insomnia is often the symptom that first brings people with depression to seek medical help; suicide risk must be screened immediately

red_flags_en.finding: Insomnia has become an ongoing problem affecting daytime function
red_flags_en.rationale: MedlinePlus advises contacting a provider once insomnia becomes a problem, and screening for comorbid depression

records.definition_zh: 心悸是患者自覺心中悸動不安、驚惕不寧，甚則不能自主的病證，可呈陣發性或持續性。
records.definition_en: Xin Ji (Palpitations) is a disease in which the patient subjectively feels the heart pounding, racing, or fluttering in an unsettled way, sometimes to the point of being unable to control it. It may be paroxysmal or continuous.
records.etiology_zh: 多因體虛久病（心之氣血陰陽不足）、驚恐惱怒、飲食勞倦，或痰飲、瘀血內阻心脈所致。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by chronic illness or constitutional weakness (deficiency of Heart Qi, Blood, Yin, or Yang), fright or anger, dietary and physical overexertion, or internal Phlegm-fluids or Blood stasis obstructing the Heart vessels.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 心主血脈、藏神；心之氣血陰陽虧虛則心失所養,或痰飲、瘀血阻遏心脈、擾動心神,皆令心動失常而悸。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Heart governs the blood vessels and houses the Shen. Deficiency of Heart Qi, Blood, Yin, or Yang leaves the Heart unnourished; alternatively, Phlegm-fluids or Blood stasis obstructing the Heart vessels disturbs the Heart Shen — either mechanism disrupts the normal heartbeat and produces palpitations.
key_manifestations_zh: 自覺心跳異常（快、慢或不規則）
心慌不安、驚惕
可伴胸悶、氣短
勞累、情緒激動時誘發或加重
重者伴頭暈、乏力
key_manifestations_en: Subjective awareness of an abnormal heartbeat (fast, slow, or irregular)
A fluttering, unsettled sensation with fright
May accompany chest oppression or shortness of breath
Triggered or worsened by exertion or emotional excitement
Severe cases accompanied by dizziness or weakness
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在心，與肝、脾、腎關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Heart, closely related to the Liver, Spleen, and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以補虛瀉實、養心安神為總則：氣血陰陽虧虛者隨證補益，痰飲、瘀血內阻者化痰、活血並安神定悸。
records.treatment_principle_en: The overall principle is to supplement vacuity, drain excess, and nourish the Heart to calm the Shen: for Qi, Blood, Yin, or Yang deficiency, tonify accordingly; for Phlegm-fluid or Blood stasis obstruction, transform Phlegm or invigorate Blood while calming the Shen and settling the palpitations.

red_flags_zh.finding: 意識喪失、胸痛、呼吸困難、異常出汗、頭暈或暈厥前兆
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能提示危險性心律不整或急性心臟事件

red_flags_zh.finding: 心跳每分鐘超過100下（非運動、焦慮或發燒所致）、頻繁早期收縮（每分鐘6次以上或連續3次以上）
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除心律不整

red_flags_zh.finding: 首次出現心悸，或型態與過去明顯不同
red_flags_zh.rationale: 新發或型態改變之心悸須排除心臟結構或節律病變

red_flags_en.finding: Loss of consciousness, chest pain, shortness of breath, unusual sweating, dizziness, or lightheadedness
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call 911 or seek emergency care immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate a dangerous arrhythmia or acute cardiac event

red_flags_en.finding: Heart rate over 100 bpm without exercise, anxiety, or fever; or frequent extra beats (more than 6/minute or in groups of 3+)
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out arrhythmia

red_flags_en.finding: First-ever palpitations, or a pattern clearly different from before
red_flags_en.rationale: New-onset or changed-pattern palpitations must rule out structural or rhythm disease
