records.definition_zh: 胸痺是以胸部悶痛，甚則胸痛徹背、喘息不得臥為主要表現的病證，多因胸陽不振，痰濁、瘀血痺阻心脈所致，相當於現代醫學冠心病心絞痛等範疇。
records.definition_en: Xiong Bi (Chest Bi) is characterized by chest oppression and pain, with severe cases showing pain penetrating to the back and inability to lie flat due to dyspnea; it is usually due to weakened chest Yang allowing Phlegm-turbidity or Blood stasis to obstruct the Heart vessels, roughly corresponding to angina/coronary artery disease in biomedicine.
records.etiology_zh: 年老體虛，胸陽不振；情志失調，氣滯血瘀；飲食不節，痰濁內生；寒邪內侵，陰寒凝滯，均可痺阻心脈。
records.etiology_en: Old age and debility weakening chest Yang; emotional disturbance causing Qi stagnation and Blood stasis; dietary irregularity generating internal Phlegm-turbidity; and Cold invasion causing Yin-Cold congealing can all obstruct the Heart vessels.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 心主血脈，賴胸陽以溫煦推動；胸陽不足，陰寒、痰濁、瘀血乘虛痺阻心脈，「不通則痛」，故見胸悶胸痛；病情深重者心脈痺阻嚴重，甚則心陽暴脫。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Heart governs the vessels, relying on chest Yang for warmth and propulsion. Insufficient chest Yang allows Yin-Cold, Phlegm-turbidity, or Blood stasis to obstruct the Heart vessels — "obstruction causing pain" — producing chest oppression and pain. In severe cases, marked obstruction of the Heart vessels may lead to sudden collapse of Heart Yang.
key_manifestations_zh: 胸部悶痛，或刺痛、絞痛
疼痛可放射至肩背、左臂
因勞累、寒冷或情緒激動誘發
休息或含服藥物可緩解
重者胸痛徹背、喘息不得臥、面色蒼白、冷汗淋漓
key_manifestations_en: Chest oppression and pain, or stabbing/cramping pain
Pain may radiate to shoulder, back, or left arm
Triggered by exertion, cold, or emotional agitation
Relieved by rest or sublingual medication
Severe cases: pain penetrating to the back, dyspnea preventing lying flat, pale complexion, cold sweating
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在心，與肝、脾、腎相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Heart, related to the Liver, Spleen, and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 發作期以通陽宣痺、活血化瘀、辛溫散寒或豁痰理氣為主，標實為急；緩解期補益心氣、溫補心陽或滋補心陰，標本兼顧。
records.treatment_principle_en: During attacks, prioritize the branch (excess): free Yang and open obstruction, invigorate Blood and dispel stasis, warmly disperse Cold, or resolve Phlegm and regulate Qi. Between attacks, tonify Heart Qi, warmly tonify Heart Yang, or nourish Heart Yin, addressing root and branch together.

red_flags_zh.finding: 胸部中央出現壓迫感、緊縮感或悶痛，持續數分鐘以上或反覆發作
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即撥打119，不要自行開車就醫
red_flags_zh.rationale: 典型心肌梗塞表現

red_flags_zh.finding: 胸痛合併肩、頸、下巴、手臂放射痛，伴冷汗、噁心或呼吸困難
red_flags_zh.rationale: 心肌梗塞警訊，女性可能以呼吸困難、噁心為主要表現

red_flags_zh.finding: 已知有心絞痛病史，胸痛持續超過5分鐘未緩解
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示穩定型心絞痛惡化為急性冠心症候群
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Warning signs and symptoms of heart disease" (medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000775.htm), retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_en.finding: Pressure, tightness, or oppressive pain in the center of the chest lasting several minutes or recurring
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call 911 immediately; do not drive yourself
red_flags_en.rationale: Classic heart attack presentation

red_flags_en.finding: Chest pain radiating to shoulder, neck, jaw, or arm, with cold sweat, nausea, or shortness of breath
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Go to the emergency department immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: Heart attack warning sign; women may present predominantly with dyspnea and nausea

red_flags_en.finding: Known angina with chest pain lasting more than 5 minutes without relief
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests progression of stable angina to acute coronary syndrome
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus "Warning signs and symptoms of heart disease" (medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000775.htm), retrieved 2026-08-11

records.definition_zh: 鬱證是因情志不遂、氣機鬱滯所致，以心情抑鬱、情緒不寧、胸脅脹滿疼痛，或易怒善哭、咽中如有異物梗塞等為主要表現的病證。
records.definition_en: Yu Zheng (Depression Pattern Disease) arises from emotional frustration and Qi stagnation, presenting mainly with depressed mood, emotional unease, chest and rib-side distension and pain, or irritability with a tendency to cry, or a sensation of something obstructing the throat.
records.etiology_zh: 多因情志所傷（憂思、惱怒、悲哀）、素體肝旺或稟賦不足，日久氣鬱化火、化痰，或耗傷心脾氣血、肝腎之陰所致。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by emotional injury (worry, anger, grief), a constitutionally hyperactive Liver, or constitutional weakness. Over time, Qi stagnation may transform into Fire or generate Phlegm, or may exhaust Heart-Spleen Qi-Blood or Liver-Kidney Yin.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肝主疏泄；情志不遂則肝氣鬱結,氣機失於條達;鬱久化火則見急躁易怒,鬱結成痰則見咽中梗塞（梅核氣）,病久耗傷心脾則心神失養,累及肝腎則陰虛火旺。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Liver governs the free flow of Qi. Emotional frustration causes Liver Qi to bind and stagnate, so Qi fails to move smoothly. Prolonged stagnation transforming into Fire produces irritability and a short temper; stagnation congealing into Phlegm produces a throat-obstruction sensation (Plum-Pit Qi); prolonged illness exhausting the Heart and Spleen leaves the Shen unnourished; and involvement of the Liver and Kidney produces Yin deficiency with Fire flaring.
key_manifestations_zh: 情緒抑鬱、悶悶不樂
胸脅脹滿或走竄疼痛
善太息（喜歎氣）
咽中如有異物梗塞（梅核氣）
急躁易怒或易哭善悲
失眠、健忘
key_manifestations_en: Depressed mood, feeling low-spirited
Chest and rib-side distension or migrating pain
Frequent sighing
Sensation of something obstructing the throat (Plum-Pit Qi)
Irritability with a short temper, or a tendency toward sadness and crying
Insomnia, poor memory
records.disease_location_zh: 病位主要在肝，與心、脾、腎相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is primarily the Liver, related to the Heart, Spleen, and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以疏肝理氣解鬱為主要治法，隨證兼以清肝瀉火、化痰散結、健脾養心或滋養肝腎。
records.treatment_principle_en: The primary treatment method is to soothe the Liver, regulate Qi, and resolve constraint; depending on the pattern this is combined with clearing Liver Fire, transforming Phlegm and dissipating binds, fortifying the Spleen and nourishing the Heart, or nourishing the Liver and Kidney.

red_flags_zh.finding: 出現傷害自己或他人的想法、計畫或行為
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即撥打988自殺與危機專線或119，或前往急診；若已發生自傷行為應立即撥打119並陪同在旁
red_flags_zh.rationale: 自殺意念與行為是精神科急症，須立即介入

red_flags_zh.finding: 出現與外界無關之幻聽等精神病症狀
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示合併精神病性特徵，需專科評估

red_flags_zh.finding: 情緒困擾已明顯影響工作、學業或家庭功能
red_flags_zh.rationale: 應在問題出現早期即尋求治療

red_flags_en.finding: Thoughts, plans, or actions of harming self or others
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or 911 immediately, or go to the emergency room; if self-harm has already occurred, call 911 and stay with the person
red_flags_en.rationale: Suicidal ideation and behavior are psychiatric emergencies requiring immediate intervention

red_flags_en.finding: Hallucinations unrelated to external stimuli
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests depression with psychotic features requiring specialist evaluation

red_flags_en.finding: Emotional distress clearly impairing work, school, or family function
red_flags_en.rationale: Treatment should be sought at the earliest sign of a problem

records.classical_source: 金匱要略·婦人病脈證并治
records.definition_zh: 臟躁是以精神恍惚、悲傷欲哭、不能自主，甚則言行失常、呵欠頻作為主要表現的病證，多見於女性，與情志內傷、臟陰不足有關，首載於《金匱要略》。
records.definition_en: Zang Zao (Visceral Agitation) is characterized by mental absent-mindedness, uncontrollable sad weeping, and severe cases with erratic speech/behavior and frequent yawning; it occurs mainly in women and is related to internal emotional damage with Zang-Yin insufficiency; first recorded in the Jin Gui Yao Lue.
records.etiology_zh: 情志不遂，憂思過度；素體陰血不足，復加操勞思慮；產後或經期陰血耗傷，臟陰虧虛，心神失養。
records.etiology_en: Emotional frustration with excessive worry and rumination; constitutional Yin-Blood insufficiency compounded by overwork and rumination; or postpartum/menstrual Yin-Blood depletion leading to Zang-Yin deficiency that fails to nourish the Heart-spirit.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 五臟陰血不足，尤以心、肝、脾為主，臟陰虧虛則心神失養，虛火內擾，神不守舍，故見悲傷欲哭、不能自主；病程日久，陰虛更甚，則變證叢生。
records.pathomechanism_en: Insufficiency of Yin-Blood in the five Zang organs, especially the Heart, Liver, and Spleen, deprives the Heart-spirit of nourishment; deficiency Fire disturbs internally and the spirit fails to stay housed, producing uncontrollable sad weeping. With a prolonged course, Yin deficiency worsens and transformed patterns proliferate.
key_manifestations_zh: 精神恍惚、情緒不穩
悲傷欲哭，不能自主控制
呵欠頻作
心煩失眠
甚則言行失常、喜怒無常
key_manifestations_en: Mental absent-mindedness, emotional instability
Uncontrollable sad weeping
Frequent yawning
Vexation and insomnia
Severe cases: erratic speech/behavior, unpredictable mood swings
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在心，與肝、脾相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Heart, related to the Liver and Spleen.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 治宜甘潤緩急、養心安神，佐以疏肝解鬱；陰虛火旺者滋陰降火；肝鬱明顯者疏肝理氣，甘麥大棗湯為臨床代表方。
records.treatment_principle_en: Treatment uses sweet-moistening herbs to relax urgency and nourish the Heart to calm the spirit, assisted by soothing the Liver and resolving depression; Yin-deficiency Fire-flaring cases nourish Yin and downbear Fire; marked Liver depression cases soothe the Liver and regulate Qi. Gan Mai Da Zao Tang is the classical representative formula.

red_flags_zh.finding: 出現自傷或自殺意念、計畫或企圖
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即撥打988自殺與危機救助專線或送急診，尋求緊急精神科評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 悲傷欲哭、情緒失控須與重度憂鬱症鑑別，後者可能伴自殺風險
red_flags_zh.source: reused from Batch A ledger: MedlinePlus "Major Depression" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000945.htm), retrieved 2026-08-11 (988 crisis line)

red_flags_zh.finding: 言行失常持續加重，或出現幻覺、妄想等精神病性症狀
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需與器質性精神疾病或重度情感障礙鑑別，避免延誤精神科治療
red_flags_zh.source: reused from Batch A ledger: MedlinePlus "Major Depression" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000945.htm), retrieved 2026-08-11 — general psychiatric-emergency reasoning extended to psychotic symptoms

red_flags_en.finding: Presence of self-harm or suicidal ideation, plan, or attempt
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline or go to the emergency department immediately for urgent psychiatric evaluation
red_flags_en.rationale: Uncontrollable weeping and emotional dysregulation must be differentiated from major depression, which carries suicide risk
red_flags_en.source: reused from Batch A ledger: MedlinePlus "Major Depression" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000945.htm), retrieved 2026-08-11 (988 crisis line)

red_flags_en.finding: Progressively worsening erratic speech/behavior, or onset of hallucinations/delusions
red_flags_en.rationale: Must be differentiated from organic psychiatric disease or severe mood disorder to avoid delaying psychiatric treatment
red_flags_en.source: reused from Batch A ledger: MedlinePlus "Major Depression" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000945.htm), retrieved 2026-08-11 — general psychiatric-emergency reasoning extended to psychotic symptoms

records.definition_zh: 梅核氣是以自覺咽中有異物梗阻，如梅核堵塞，咯之不出、吞之不下，但不影響進食為主要表現的病證，多因肝氣鬱結、痰氣互結於咽喉所致。
records.definition_en: Mei He Qi (Plum-Pit Qi, globus) is characterized by a subjective sensation of an obstruction in the throat like a plum pit, unable to be coughed out or swallowed down, but without interfering with actual eating; usually due to Liver Qi stagnation with Phlegm-Qi binding in the throat.
records.etiology_zh: 情志不遂，肝氣鬱結，氣鬱化痰；或思慮過度，脾失健運，痰濕內生，痰氣循經上逆，結於咽喉。
records.etiology_en: Emotional frustration causing Liver Qi stagnation which transforms into Phlegm; or excessive rumination impairing Spleen transportation, generating internal Phlegm-Damp that travels along the channel and rebels upward to bind in the throat.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肝主疏泄，喜條達；情志不遂則肝氣鬱結，氣機不暢，津液不布，聚而為痰；痰氣互結，循肝經上逆，結於咽喉，故自覺咽中異物梗阻；此病咽部並無器質性阻塞，不影響飲食吞嚥。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Liver governs free coursing and favors unimpeded flow. Emotional frustration causes Liver Qi stagnation, impairing Qi movement so fluids fail to distribute and accumulate as Phlegm. Phlegm and Qi bind together, travel up the Liver channel, and lodge in the throat, producing the subjective sensation of a foreign-body obstruction. There is no actual structural obstruction and swallowing/eating remain unaffected.
key_manifestations_zh: 自覺咽中有異物感，如梅核梗阻
咯之不出、吞之不下
情緒波動時加重
不影響正常飲食吞嚥
可伴胸脅脹悶、噯氣
key_manifestations_en: Subjective foreign-body sensation in the throat, like a plum pit
Cannot be coughed out or swallowed down
Worsens with emotional fluctuation
Does not interfere with normal eating and swallowing
May accompany chest/rib-side distension and belching
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在咽喉，與肝、脾、肺相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the throat, related to the Liver, Spleen, and Lung.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 治宜疏肝解鬱、化痰散結、行氣開鬱，佐以理氣寬胸。
records.treatment_principle_en: Treatment soothes the Liver and resolves depression, transforms Phlegm and dissipates binding, moves Qi and relieves depression, assisted by regulating Qi and opening the chest.

red_flags_zh.finding: 出現真正的吞嚥困難（食物或液體卡在食道）、體重減輕，或吞嚥時嗆咳、呼吸困難
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速轉診耳鼻喉科或腸胃科，安排內視鏡等檢查排除器質性病變
red_flags_zh.rationale: 梅核氣的關鍵鑑別點是「咯之不出、吞之不下但不影響進食」；一旦出現真性吞嚥困難或體重減輕，須排除食道腫瘤等嚴重器質性疾病
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Swallowing problems" (medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000065.htm — "Contact your provider if: You cough or have fever or shortness of breath. You are losing weight. Your swallowing problems are getting worse"), retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_zh.finding: 咳嗽、發燒或呼吸困難合併吞嚥不順
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示吸入性風險或感染，需醫療介入

red_flags_en.finding: True dysphagia (food or liquid getting stuck in the esophagus), weight loss, or coughing/choking or breathing difficulty when swallowing
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Refer promptly to ENT or gastroenterology for endoscopy to rule out structural disease
red_flags_en.rationale: The key differentiator for Plum-Pit Qi is that it does not obstruct actual eating; true dysphagia or weight loss must raise concern for esophageal tumor or other serious structural disease
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus "Swallowing problems" (medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000065.htm — "Contact your provider if: You cough or have fever or shortness of breath. You are losing weight. Your swallowing problems are getting worse"), retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_en.finding: Cough, fever, or shortness of breath together with swallowing difficulty
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests aspiration risk or infection requiring medical intervention

records.definition_zh: 健忘是以記憶力減退、遇事善忘為主要表現的病證，多因心脾兩虛、腎精不足，或痰瘀阻竅，腦髓失養所致。
records.definition_en: Jian Wang (Poor Memory) is characterized by declining memory and forgetfulness, usually due to Heart-Spleen dual deficiency, Kidney Essence insufficiency, or Phlegm-stasis obstructing the orifices, depriving the brain marrow of nourishment.
records.etiology_zh: 思慮過度，勞傷心脾；年老體衰，腎精虧虛；情志不遂，氣鬱痰阻；久病入絡，瘀血阻竅。
records.etiology_en: Excessive rumination taxing the Heart and Spleen; age-related decline with Kidney Essence depletion; emotional frustration causing Qi depression and Phlegm obstruction; or chronic disease entering the network vessels with Blood stasis obstructing the orifices.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 心主神明，脾主思，腎主藏精生髓，腦為髓海；凡心脾兩虛，氣血生化不足，不能上榮腦髓；或腎精虧損，髓海失充；或痰濁、瘀血蒙蔽清竅，皆可使神明失聰，發為健忘。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Heart governs the spirit-mind, the Spleen governs thought, and the Kidney stores Essence and generates Marrow, with the brain as the "Sea of Marrow." Heart-Spleen dual deficiency with insufficient Qi-Blood generation failing to nourish the brain marrow, Kidney Essence depletion leaving the Sea of Marrow unfilled, or Phlegm-turbidity/Blood stasis clouding the clear orifices can all impair the spirit-mind and produce forgetfulness.
key_manifestations_zh: 記憶力減退，遇事善忘
心悸、失眠多夢
可伴神疲乏力、頭暈耳鳴
痰瘀阻竅者可伴頭重如裹或健忘兼見胸悶
key_manifestations_en: Declining memory, forgetfulness
Palpitations, insomnia with excessive dreaming
May accompany fatigue, dizziness, tinnitus
Phlegm-stasis type: may accompany heavy-wrapped head sensation or forgetfulness with chest oppression
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在腦，與心、脾、腎相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the brain, related to the Heart, Spleen, and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 心脾兩虛者補益心脾、養血安神；腎精虧虛者補腎益精、填髓健腦；痰瘀阻竅者化痰活血、開竅醒神。
records.treatment_principle_en: Heart-Spleen dual deficiency: tonify the Heart and Spleen, nourish Blood and calm the spirit. Kidney Essence depletion: tonify the Kidney and boost Essence, replenish Marrow and strengthen the brain. Phlegm-stasis obstructing the orifices: transform Phlegm and invigorate Blood, open the orifices and revive the spirit.

red_flags_zh.finding: 突發性意識狀態改變（如異常行為、意識混亂、難以喚醒）
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需緊急排除中風、顱內出血、代謝異常等急症，而非單純健忘
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Recognizing medical emergencies" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/001927.htm — "Change in mental status (such as unusual behavior, confusion, difficulty arousing)"), retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_zh.finding: 記憶減退合併日常生活功能明顯受影響，或短時間內快速惡化
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速轉診神經科/記憶門診評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需與失智症、輕度認知障礙鑑別，及早診斷可及早介入
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Memory loss" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003257.htm) general guidance synthesis: normal aging does not cause dramatic memory loss; dramatic/rapidly progressive memory loss warrants evaluation, retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden change in mental status (unusual behavior, confusion, difficulty arousing)
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call 911 or go to the emergency department immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: Must urgently rule out stroke, intracranial hemorrhage, or metabolic emergency rather than assuming simple forgetfulness

red_flags_en.finding: Memory decline with significant impact on daily functioning, or rapid worsening over a short time
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Refer promptly to neurology / memory clinic
red_flags_en.rationale: Must differentiate from dementia or mild cognitive impairment; early diagnosis allows earlier intervention
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus "Memory loss" (medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003257.htm) — normal aging does not cause dramatic memory loss, retrieved 2026-08-11

records.definition_zh: 消渴是以多飲、多食、多尿、形體消瘦，或尿有甜味為主要表現的病證，古代依偏重上、中、下三消分類。
records.definition_en: Xiao Ke (Wasting-Thirst Disease) is characterized primarily by excessive thirst, excessive hunger, excessive urination, and wasting/emaciation, sometimes with sweet-tasting urine. Classically it is divided into Upper, Middle, and Lower Wasting according to predominant symptom.
records.etiology_zh: 多因飲食不節（嗜食肥甘）、情志失調、稟賦不足，或勞欲過度，日久導致陰津虧耗、燥熱內生。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by dietary irregularity (excessive rich, sweet food), emotional disturbance, constitutional weakness, or overexertion/excessive sexual activity, which over time leads to depletion of Yin fluids and internal Dryness-Heat.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 陰虛為本、燥熱為標：肺熱津傷則口渴多飲（上消），胃熱熾盛則多食易饑（中消），腎陰虧虛、固攝失司則尿多而甜（下消）；病久陰損及陽，可見陰陽兩虛。
records.pathomechanism_en: Yin deficiency is the root and Dryness-Heat the branch: Lung Heat injuring fluids produces thirst with excessive drinking (Upper Wasting); Stomach Heat blazing produces excessive hunger and easy hunger (Middle Wasting); Kidney Yin deficiency with failed securing produces excessive, sweet urine (Lower Wasting). With prolonged illness, Yin damage can extend to Yang, producing combined Yin-Yang deficiency.
key_manifestations_zh: 多飲、口渴
多食、易饑
多尿、尿有甜味
形體消瘦
神疲乏力
key_manifestations_en: Excessive thirst and drinking
Excessive hunger, easily hungry
Excessive urination, sweet-tasting urine
Wasting/emaciation
Fatigue and lack of strength
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在肺、胃、腎，尤以腎為關鍵。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Lung, Stomach, and Kidney, with the Kidney being the key organ.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以滋陰清熱為基本治法：上消清肺潤燥，中消清胃瀉火，下消滋陰補腎；陰陽兩虛者陰陽並補。消渴需與西醫糖尿病密切配合監測血糖，不可僅以中藥替代降糖治療。
records.treatment_principle_en: The basic treatment method is to nourish Yin and clear Heat: for Upper Wasting, clear the Lung and moisten Dryness; for Middle Wasting, clear the Stomach and drain Fire; for Lower Wasting, nourish Yin and tonify the Kidney; combined Yin-Yang deficiency requires tonifying both. Xiao Ke requires close coordination with biomedical diabetes monitoring — TCM should not replace glucose-lowering treatment.

red_flags_zh.finding: 意識改變、深快呼吸、噁心嘔吐、腹痛、呼氣有果香味
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示糖尿病酮酸中毒（DKA），為致命性糖尿病急症

red_flags_zh.finding: 快速體重減輕、極度口渴、頻尿持續一天以上
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為第一型糖尿病或血糖控制急遽惡化的表現

red_flags_en.finding: Altered consciousness, deep rapid breathing, nausea/vomiting, abdominal pain, fruity-smelling breath
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek emergency care immediately or call 911
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA), a life-threatening diabetes emergency

red_flags_en.finding: Rapid weight loss, extreme thirst, frequent urination lasting more than a day
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate new-onset type 1 diabetes or acutely worsening glycemic control

records.definition_zh: 汗證是指由於陰陽失調、腠理不固所致汗液外泄失常的病證，不因外界環境或運動、衣被過厚等因素而汗出者，白晝汗出稱自汗，睡中汗出、醒後即止稱盜汗。
records.definition_en: Han Zheng (Sweating Disorders) refers to abnormal, excessive sweating due to Yin-Yang disharmony and an unconsolidated exterior (striae), not explained by environment, exercise, or heavy clothing. Daytime sweating is called Spontaneous Sweating (Zi Han); sweating during sleep that stops on waking is called Night Sweating (Dao Han).
records.etiology_zh: 自汗多因肺氣不足、衛表不固；盜汗多因陰虛內熱、迫津外泄；亦可因邪熱鬱蒸或心血不足所致。
records.etiology_en: Spontaneous sweating is most often due to Lung Qi deficiency with an unconsolidated defensive exterior. Night sweating is most often due to internal Yin-deficiency Heat forcing fluids outward. Both can also arise from pathogenic Heat steaming internally, or from Heart Blood insufficiency.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肺氣虛則衛外不固、腠理疏鬆，津液外泄而自汗；陰虛內熱者虛火迫津外泄，睡則衛陽入裡、肌表不固而盜汗，醒則衛陽復出於表而汗止。
records.pathomechanism_en: Lung Qi deficiency leaves the defensive exterior unconsolidated and the striae loose, so fluids leak outward as spontaneous sweat. In Yin deficiency with internal Heat, deficiency-fire forces fluids outward; during sleep, defensive Yang withdraws inward and the exterior is unguarded, producing night sweats, which stop on waking as defensive Yang returns to the exterior.
key_manifestations_zh: 白晝汗出，動則尤甚（自汗）
睡中汗出、醒後汗止（盜汗）
汗出部位可局限或全身
可伴倦怠乏力（自汗）或五心煩熱、口乾（盜汗）
反覆發作
key_manifestations_en: Daytime sweating, worse with exertion (Spontaneous Sweating)
Sweating during sleep that stops on waking (Night Sweating)
Sweating may be localized or generalized
May accompany fatigue (Spontaneous Sweating type) or five-center heat and dry mouth (Night Sweating type)
Recurrent pattern
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在肺衛、心，與腎陰不足相關（盜汗）。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Lung-Wei level and Heart, related to Kidney Yin insufficiency in Night Sweating.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 自汗者益氣固表止汗，盜汗者滋陰降火斂汗，兼心血不足者養血安神，濕熱鬱蒸者清熱化濕。
records.treatment_principle_en: For Spontaneous Sweating, boost Qi and consolidate the exterior to stop sweating; for Night Sweating, nourish Yin and downbear Fire while astringing sweat; where Heart Blood insufficiency coexists, nourish Blood and calm the Shen; for Damp-Heat steaming internally, clear Heat and transform Dampness.

red_flags_zh.finding: 大量出汗合併胸痛、心跳急促而強、發燒或呼吸困難
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能提示心臟疾病、甲狀腺功能亢進或感染

red_flags_zh.finding: 夜間盜汗合併不明原因體重減輕、淋巴結腫大
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除淋巴瘤、結核病等全身性疾病

red_flags_en.finding: Heavy sweating with chest pain, rapid pounding heartbeat, fever, or shortness of breath
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate cardiac disease, hyperthyroidism, or infection

red_flags_en.finding: Night sweats with unexplained weight loss or enlarged lymph nodes
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out lymphoma, tuberculosis, or another systemic disease

records.definition_zh: 虛勞是以臟腑虧損、氣血陰陽不足為主要病機，以長期虛弱證候為主要表現的多種慢性衰弱性病證的總稱，涉及多個臟腑，病程較長。
records.definition_en: Xu Lao (Consumptive Deficiency) is a general term for a group of chronic debilitating diseases whose core pathomechanism is organ depletion and Qi-Blood-Yin-Yang insufficiency, presenting as long-standing weakness; it involves multiple organs and follows a prolonged course.
records.etiology_zh: 先天稟賦不足；後天飲食失調、勞欲過度；大病久病失於調理；情志內傷，日久耗傷氣血陰陽。
records.etiology_en: Congenital constitutional insufficiency; acquired dietary imbalance and overexertion (including excessive sexual activity); major or chronic illness without proper convalescent care; or internal emotional damage gradually depleting Qi, Blood, Yin, and Yang.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 五臟虛損，氣血陰陽不足，互相影響，久則由一臟及多臟，由氣及血、及陰陽，形成氣虛、血虛、陰虛、陽虛及其相兼為病的複雜病機，病程遷延難癒。
records.pathomechanism_en: Depletion of the five Zang organs and insufficiency of Qi, Blood, Yin, and Yang mutually interact; over time deficiency spreads from one organ to several, and from Qi to Blood to Yin-Yang, forming complex combined patterns of Qi, Blood, Yin, and Yang deficiency with a protracted, difficult-to-resolve course.
key_manifestations_zh: 神疲乏力，少氣懶言
形體消瘦或虛浮
面色無華
自汗或盜汗
心悸失眠、腰膝痠軟等因證而異的多臟腑虛損表現
key_manifestations_en: Fatigue, shortness of breath, reluctance to speak
Emaciation or puffy weakness
Lusterless complexion
Spontaneous or night sweating
Palpitations, insomnia, sore weak lower back and knees, and other multi-organ deficiency signs that vary by pattern
records.disease_location_zh: 病位涉及五臟，以脾腎為根本。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location involves all five Zang organs, rooted in the Spleen and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以補益為基本原則，分辨氣血陰陽虛損，分別益氣、養血、滋陰、溫陽，重視調補脾腎二臟，不可濫補、蠻補。
records.treatment_principle_en: The basic principle is tonification, differentiating Qi, Blood, Yin, and Yang deficiency and tonifying accordingly (boosting Qi, nourishing Blood, nourishing Yin, or warming Yang), with emphasis on regulating and tonifying the Spleen and Kidney; indiscriminate or excessive tonification should be avoided.

red_flags_zh.finding: 非刻意之下體重減輕超過4.5公斤（10磅）或體重的5%，發生於6-12個月內且原因不明
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速就醫檢查潛在病因
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示可能為惡性腫瘤、慢性感染或內分泌代謝疾病等器質性病因，需與單純虛勞鑑別

red_flags_zh.finding: 體重減輕合併其他症狀（如發燒、疼痛、出血等）
red_flags_zh.rationale: 合併症狀提高器質性疾病的可能性

red_flags_en.finding: Unintentional weight loss of more than 10 pounds (4.5 kg) or 5% of body weight over 6-12 months, cause unknown
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek prompt medical evaluation for underlying cause
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate malignancy, chronic infection, or endocrine/metabolic disease; must be differentiated from simple consumptive deficiency

red_flags_en.finding: Weight loss accompanied by other symptoms (e.g. fever, pain, bleeding)
red_flags_en.rationale: Accompanying symptoms raise the likelihood of organic disease

records.definition_zh: 肥胖是指因飲食、勞逸失調或臟腑功能失調，痰濕膏脂內生，體重超過正常標準，並伴有身重乏力、活動不利等表現的病證。
records.definition_en: Obesity (肥胖) in TCM refers to excess accumulation of Phlegm-Damp and fatty turbidity arising from dietary irregularity, imbalance of activity and rest, or organ dysfunction, presenting as body weight above normal standards along with heaviness, fatigue, and reduced ease of movement.
records.etiology_zh: 多因飲食不節、嗜食肥甘厚味，或久坐少動、好逸惡勞，或先天稟賦不足、脾腎虛弱，或情志失調、肝鬱氣滯，致使水濕運化失常，痰濕膏脂內聚。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by unrestrained eating of rich, greasy foods; prolonged sedentary habits with little exercise; congenital Spleen-Kidney weakness; or emotional disturbance with Liver Qi stagnation — all of which impair the transformation of water-damp and allow Phlegm-Damp and fatty turbidity to accumulate.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 脾主運化水濕，脾失健運則水濕停聚、痰濁內生；痰濕日久化熱，或阻遏氣機，或流注肌膚，致形體肥胖；病久及腎，脾腎陽虛，氣化無力，痰濕更甚，形成惡性循環。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Spleen governs the transformation of water-damp; when Spleen transportive function fails, water-damp accumulates and turns into internal Phlegm-turbidity. Over time, Phlegm-Damp may transform into Heat, obstruct the movement of Qi, or infiltrate the flesh, producing obesity. With prolonged illness the Kidney is affected, Spleen-Kidney Yang becomes deficient, Qi transformation weakens, and Phlegm-Damp worsens in a self-perpetuating cycle.
key_manifestations_zh: 體重明顯超過正常標準，形體臃腫
身重困倦，肢體乏力
胸悶脘痞，或食欲亢進
動則氣短、汗多
常兼見大便黏滯或便秘
key_manifestations_en: Body weight substantially above normal, with a bulky physique
Heaviness and lethargy of the body, limb fatigue
Chest oppression and epigastric fullness, or increased appetite
Shortness of breath and excessive sweating on exertion
Often accompanied by sticky stool or constipation
records.disease_location_zh: 病位主要在脾，與腎、肝、胃密切相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is primarily the Spleen, closely related to the Kidney, Liver, and Stomach.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以化痰祛濕、健脾益氣為基本原則；胃熱濕阻者清胃泄熱化濕，肝鬱氣滯者疏肝理氣，脾腎陽虛者溫補脾腎。
records.treatment_principle_en: The basic principle is to transform Phlegm, eliminate Dampness, and strengthen the Spleen to tonify Qi. For Stomach Heat with Damp obstruction, clear Stomach Heat and eliminate Damp; for Liver Qi stagnation, soothe the Liver and regulate Qi; for Spleen-Kidney Yang deficiency, warmly tonify the Spleen and Kidney.

red_flags_zh.finding: 合併第二型糖尿病、心臟病、阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症或其他代謝相關共病之徵象
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 建議轉介西醫評估代謝與心肺共病
red_flags_zh.rationale: 肥胖顯著增加第二型糖尿病、心臟病、阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症及部分癌症風險
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Obesity" (ency/article/007297.htm), Surgery section, retrieved 2026-08-11: "Arthritis, Asthma, Type 2 diabetes, Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), Heart disease, High blood pressure, Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease, Obstructive sleep apnea, Some cancers, Stroke"

red_flags_en.finding: Signs of comorbid type 2 diabetes, heart disease, obstructive sleep apnea, or other metabolic complications
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Recommend referral for biomedical evaluation of metabolic and cardiopulmonary comorbidities
red_flags_en.rationale: Obesity substantially increases risk of type 2 diabetes, heart disease, obstructive sleep apnea, and some cancers

records.definition_zh: 癭病是以頸前喉結兩旁結塊腫大為主要特徵的病證，包括癭氣、肉癭、石癭等類型，相當於現代醫學甲狀腺腫大相關疾病。
records.definition_en: Goiter Disease (癭病) is characterized by swelling or nodular masses on either side of the laryngeal prominence in the anterior neck; it encompasses several classical subtypes (癭氣/肉癭/石癭) and broadly corresponds to thyroid enlargement disorders in modern medicine.
records.etiology_zh: 多因情志不遂，肝氣鬱結，氣機不暢；或飲食失調、水土因素，影響脾胃運化，痰濕內生；氣滯痰凝壅結頸前，久則血行不暢，痰瘀互結。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by emotional distress with Liver Qi stagnation and impaired flow of Qi; or dietary irregularity and regional water/soil factors that disturb Spleen-Stomach transportation and generate internal Phlegm-Damp. Qi stagnation and Phlegm congeal in the anterior neck, and with time Blood flow is impeded, so Phlegm and stasis bind together.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肝鬱氣滯為病之始動，氣滯則津液不布，凝聚成痰，痰氣壅結頸前發為癭腫；日久氣滯痰凝化熱，或痰瘀互結，腫塊質地漸硬；病久傷及陰血，可見心肝陰虛之候。
records.pathomechanism_en: Liver Qi stagnation is the initiating mechanism — stagnant Qi fails to distribute fluids, which congeal into Phlegm; Phlegm and Qi bind in the anterior neck to form the goiter. Over time, stagnant Qi and congealed Phlegm may transform into Heat, or Phlegm and stasis intertwine, causing the mass to harden; prolonged illness damages Yin-Blood, producing signs of Heart-Liver Yin deficiency.
key_manifestations_zh: 頸前喉結兩旁結塊或腫大，隨吞咽上下移動
腫塊初起柔軟，日久可漸硬或成結節
可伴煩躁易怒、心悸多汗（氣鬱化火者）
或見神疲乏力、頸部壓迫感（氣虛痰凝者）
病久腫塊質硬、推之不移者，需高度警惕
key_manifestations_en: A mass or swelling on either side of the laryngeal prominence that moves up and down with swallowing
Initially soft, the mass may gradually harden or become nodular over time
May be accompanied by irritability, easy anger, palpitations, and profuse sweating (Qi stagnation transforming into Fire)
Or fatigue and a sensation of neck pressure (Qi deficiency with Phlegm congealing)
A long-standing, hard, immobile mass warrants heightened vigilance
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在頸前，與肝、脾、心關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the anterior neck, closely related to the Liver, Spleen, and Heart.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以理氣化痰、消癭散結為基本治法；肝火旺盛者清肝瀉火，陰虛者滋陰降火，痰瘀互結者化痰活血軟堅。
records.treatment_principle_en: The basic method is to regulate Qi, transform Phlegm, and dissipate the goiter mass. For Liver Fire, clear the Liver and drain Fire; for Yin deficiency, nourish Yin and lower Fire; for combined Phlegm and stasis, transform Phlegm, invigorate Blood, and soften hardness.

red_flags_zh.finding: 頸前出現腫塊或其他甲狀腺腫大相關症狀
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 建議就醫評估甲狀腺功能與結構
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需釐清腫大原因與甲狀腺功能狀態
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Simple goiter" (ency/article/001178.htm), When to Contact a Medical Professional, retrieved 2026-08-11: "Contact your provider if you experience any swelling in the front of your neck or any other symptoms of a goiter."

red_flags_zh.finding: 極大癭腫合併呼吸困難（尤其平躺或舉臂時）或吞嚥困難（尤其固體食物）
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示腫大甲狀腺壓迫氣管或食道，罕見但屬嚴重併發症
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Simple goiter" (ency/article/001178.htm), Symptoms section, retrieved 2026-08-11: "Breathing difficulties (with very large goiters), especially when lying flat on the back or when reaching up with your arms" / "Swallowing difficulties, especially with solid food."

red_flags_en.finding: A mass or swelling in the anterior neck, or other symptoms of goiter
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Recommend medical evaluation of thyroid structure and function
red_flags_en.rationale: Need to clarify the cause of the swelling and thyroid functional status
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus "Simple goiter" (ency/article/001178.htm), When to Contact a Medical Professional, retrieved 2026-08-11: "Contact your provider if you experience any swelling in the front of your neck or any other symptoms of a goiter."

red_flags_en.finding: Very large goiter with breathing difficulty (especially lying flat or reaching overhead) or swallowing difficulty (especially with solid food)
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests the enlarged thyroid is compressing the trachea or esophagus — rare but a serious complication

records.definition_zh: 淋證是以小便頻數、淋漓澀痛、小腹拘急引痛為主症的病證，依主症兼夾不同分為熱淋、石淋、氣淋、血淋、膏淋、勞淋六類。
records.definition_en: Lin Zheng (Strangury) is a disease characterized by frequent, dribbling, painful urination with lower abdominal tension and referred pain. It is classically divided into six types by predominant feature: Heat Lin, Stone Lin, Qi Lin, Blood Lin, Cloudy (Chyluria) Lin, and Fatigue Lin.
records.etiology_zh: 多因濕熱下注膀胱，或情志失調氣滯膀胱，或砂石內結，或久病脾腎兩虛、膀胱氣化無力所致。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by Damp-Heat pouring down into the Bladder, emotional disturbance causing Qi stagnation in the Bladder, internal formation of stone/gravel, or chronic illness with Spleen-Kidney dual deficiency weakening Bladder Qi transformation.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 膀胱主藏津液、司氣化；濕熱蘊結膀胱則氣化失司、水道不利而為熱淋；砂石內結、氣滯血瘀者亦阻遏水道；久病脾腎兩虛則膀胱氣化無力、淋證遇勞即發，稱勞淋。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Bladder stores fluids and governs Qi transformation. Damp-Heat accumulating in the Bladder impairs Qi transformation and obstructs the waterways, producing Heat Lin. Internal stone formation or Qi stagnation with Blood stasis likewise obstructs the waterways. Chronic Spleen-Kidney dual deficiency weakens Bladder Qi transformation so the condition flares with exertion — termed Fatigue Lin.
key_manifestations_zh: 小便頻數、短澀
排尿灼熱刺痛
小腹拘急疼痛，或引腰腹
尿中夾砂石（石淋）或血（血淋）或混濁如膏（膏淋）
遇勞即發或加重（勞淋）
key_manifestations_en: Frequent, scant, hesitant urination
Burning, stabbing pain on urination
Lower abdominal tension and pain, sometimes radiating to the back
Gravel in the urine (Stone Lin), blood (Blood Lin), or cloudy discharge (Cloudy/Chyluria Lin)
Triggered or worsened by exertion (Fatigue Lin)
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在腎與膀胱，與肝、脾相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Kidney and Bladder, related to the Liver and Spleen.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以清熱利濕通淋為基本治法：熱淋清熱瀉火，石淋排石通淋，氣淋理氣，血淋涼血止血，膏淋分清泌濁，勞淋補脾益腎。
records.treatment_principle_en: The basic treatment method is to clear Heat, disinhibit Dampness, and free the strangury: for Heat Lin, clear Heat and drain Fire; for Stone Lin, expel stones and free the strangury; for Qi Lin, regulate Qi; for Blood Lin, cool the Blood and stop bleeding; for Cloudy Lin, separate the clear from the turbid; for Fatigue Lin, tonify the Spleen and Kidney.

red_flags_zh.finding: 發燒、後背或側腹疼痛、寒顫、嘔吐
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示腎盂腎炎（上泌尿道感染），須立即就醫

red_flags_zh.finding: 抗生素治療後淋證症狀短期內復發
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示治療不完全或抗藥性感染

red_flags_en.finding: Fever, back or side pain, chills, vomiting
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests pyelonephritis (upper urinary tract infection) requiring immediate care

red_flags_en.finding: Symptoms recur shortly after antibiotic treatment
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests incomplete treatment or a resistant infection

records.definition_zh: 癃閉是以小便量少、點滴而出，甚則小便閉塞不通為主要表現的病證，癃者小便不暢、點滴而短少，閉者小便閉塞、點滴不通，二者輕重不同，同屬一類病證。
records.definition_en: Long Bi (Urinary Retention/Dribbling) is characterized by scanty, dribbling urination, with severe cases showing complete urinary blockage; "Long" refers to difficult, scanty dribbling urination and "Bi" to complete blockage — differing in severity but belonging to the same disease category.
records.etiology_zh: 濕熱蘊結膀胱，或肺熱氣壅、脾氣不升、肝鬱氣滯，均可致膀胱氣化不利；腎陽虛衰，命門火衰，亦可致氣化無權；或尿路瘀阻、敗精、砂石阻塞。
records.etiology_en: Damp-Heat accumulating in the Bladder, or Lung Heat congesting Qi, Spleen Qi failing to ascend, or Liver depression Qi stagnation, can all impair Bladder Qi transformation; Kidney Yang decline with weakened Gate of Vitality Fire can also cause loss of Qi-transformation power; or the urinary tract may be obstructed by stasis, degenerated essence, or stones.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 膀胱為州都之官，賴腎陽溫煦、肺脾腎三焦氣化方能正常排尿；凡濕熱、氣滯、瘀阻等實邪壅塞，或腎陽虛衰、氣化無權，均可致膀胱氣化功能失常，發為癃閉。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Bladder is the "official of the regional cities"; normal urination depends on Kidney Yang warmth and the Qi-transformation of the Lung, Spleen, Kidney, and Triple Burner. Excess pathogens such as Damp-Heat, Qi stagnation, or stasis obstruction, or Kidney Yang decline with loss of Qi-transformation power, can all disrupt Bladder Qi transformation and produce urinary retention.
key_manifestations_zh: 小便量少，點滴而下，或小便閉塞不通
小腹脹滿或疼痛
可伴腰痛、排尿困難、尿線變細
虛證者小便無力，伴神疲畏寒
key_manifestations_en: Scanty, dribbling urination, or complete urinary blockage
Lower abdominal distension or pain
May accompany low back pain, difficulty urinating, thin urine stream
Deficiency type: weak urine stream with fatigue and cold intolerance
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在膀胱，與腎、肺、脾、肝相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Bladder, related to the Kidney, Lung, Spleen, and Liver.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 實證清熱利濕、行氣活血、通利小便；虛證溫補腎陽、化氣行水；若小便閉塞、脹急難忍者，當先用導尿等法急則治標，再辨證論治。
records.treatment_principle_en: Excess patterns: clear Heat, drain Dampness, move Qi and Blood, and disinhibit urination. Deficiency patterns: warmly tonify Kidney Yang and transform Qi to move water. When retention is severe and distension is unbearable, urgent measures such as catheterization should treat the branch first before pattern-based treatment resumes.

red_flags_zh.finding: 完全無法排尿
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即就醫，可能需要導尿處置
red_flags_zh.rationale: 急性尿滯留可致膀胱過度擴張及腎功能損害

red_flags_zh.finding: 發燒、嘔吐、腰背痛、寒顫，或1-2天內尿量極少
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示尿路感染上行或腎功能受損

red_flags_zh.finding: 尿中帶血、尿液混濁、頻尿急迫或有分泌物
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除感染、結石或攝護腺疾病等病因

red_flags_en.finding: Complete inability to urinate
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek immediate care; catheterization may be needed
red_flags_en.rationale: Acute urinary retention can cause bladder overdistension and kidney damage

red_flags_en.finding: Fever, vomiting, side or back pain, shaking chills, or passing little urine for 1-2 days
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests ascending urinary tract infection or kidney impairment

red_flags_en.finding: Blood in urine, cloudy urine, urgent/frequent urination, or discharge
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out infection, stones, or prostate disease

records.definition_zh: 水腫是體內水液瀦留，泛濫肌膚，引起頭面、眼瞼、四肢、腹背甚至全身浮腫為主要表現的病證，多因肺、脾、腎三臟功能失調，水液代謝障礙所致。
records.definition_en: Shui Zhong (Edema) is characterized by fluid retention overflowing into the skin, causing swelling of the head, face, eyelids, limbs, trunk, or the whole body, usually due to Lung-Spleen-Kidney dysfunction disrupting water metabolism.
records.etiology_zh: 外感風邪、瘡毒內犯，肺失通調；飲食不節，脾失健運；久病勞倦，腎失開闔；水濕、瘀血阻滯三焦。
records.etiology_en: External Wind or sore-toxin invading and impairing Lung's regulation of waterways; dietary irregularity impairing Spleen transportation; chronic illness and overexertion impairing Kidney opening-closing function; and Water-Damp or Blood stasis obstructing the Triple Burner.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肺主通調水道，脾主運化水濕，腎主水液氣化，三焦為水液運行的通道；凡風邪襲肺、脾失健運、腎失開闔，均可使水液代謝失常，泛溢肌膚而為水腫；陽水多為外邪犯肺、水濕壅盛之實證，陰水多為脾腎陽虛、水濕內停之虛證。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Lung regulates the waterways, the Spleen transforms and transports water-dampness, and the Kidney governs the Qi-transformation of water fluids, with the Triple Burner as the pathway. Wind invading the Lung, Spleen failing to transport, or Kidney failing its opening-closing can all disrupt water metabolism and cause overflow into the skin as edema. Yang edema is usually an excess pattern from external pathogens invading the Lung with Water-Damp excess; Yin edema is usually a deficiency pattern from Spleen-Kidney Yang deficiency with internal Water-Damp accumulation.
key_manifestations_zh: 頭面、眼瞼或下肢浮腫，按之凹陷或隨手而起
陽水者浮腫先見於眼瞼、頭面，發病急，可伴惡風發熱
陰水者浮腫先見於下肢，足踝為甚，發病緩，伴腰膝痠冷、神疲乏力
可伴小便量少
key_manifestations_en: Swelling of the head, face, eyelids, or lower limbs, pitting or rebounding on pressure
Yang edema: swelling first appears in the eyelids/face, acute onset, may accompany wind-aversion and fever
Yin edema: swelling first appears in the lower limbs/ankles, gradual onset, with cold aching lumbar-knees and fatigue
May accompany scanty urination
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在肺、脾、腎，與三焦、膀胱相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Lung, Spleen, and Kidney, related to the Triple Burner and Bladder.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 陽水以宣肺利水、疏風解表，或清熱利濕為主；陰水以溫腎健脾、化氣利水為主，久病陽損及陰者當陰陽並補。
records.treatment_principle_en: Yang edema: disperse Lung Qi and disinhibit water, disperse Wind and release the exterior, or clear Heat and drain Dampness. Yin edema: warmly tonify the Kidney and strengthen the Spleen, transform Qi and disinhibit water. In chronic disease where Yang deficiency has damaged Yin, tonify both Yin and Yang.

red_flags_zh.finding: 下肢或腹部水腫持續惡化，合併極度呼吸困難或心跳過快（每分鐘120-150次以上）
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示心衰竭急性惡化或肺水腫
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Warning signs and symptoms of heart disease" (medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000775.htm), retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_zh.finding: 水腫合併明顯體重增加、腹部脹大
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速就醫評估心、腎、肝功能
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示體液滯留加重，需排查心衰竭、腎病症候群或肝硬化
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Warning signs and symptoms of heart disease" (medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000775.htm), retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_en.finding: Worsening leg or abdominal edema with extreme shortness of breath or fast heart rate (over 120-150 bpm)
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call 911 or go to the emergency department immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests acute heart failure decompensation or pulmonary edema
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus "Warning signs and symptoms of heart disease" (medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000775.htm), retrieved 2026-08-11

red_flags_en.finding: Edema with marked weight gain and abdominal distension
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek prompt evaluation of cardiac, renal, and hepatic function
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests worsening fluid retention; must screen for heart failure, nephrotic syndrome, or cirrhosis
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus "Warning signs and symptoms of heart disease" (medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000775.htm), retrieved 2026-08-11

records.definition_zh: 遺尿是指三歲以上小兒或成人於睡眠中不自覺地排尿，醒後方覺的病證，亦稱「尿床」。
records.definition_en: Enuresis (遺尿) refers to involuntary urination during sleep in children over three years of age or in adults, with the person only becoming aware after waking; also known as "bedwetting."
records.etiology_zh: 多因先天稟賦不足、腎氣未充或腎氣虛衰，膀胱失於約束；或肺脾氣虛，水道通調失職；或肝經濕熱下注，擾動膀胱氣化。
records.etiology_en: Commonly due to congenital insufficiency with the Kidney Qi not yet full (in children) or Kidney Qi decline (in adults), leaving the Bladder without restraint; or Lung-Spleen Qi deficiency impairing the regulation of water pathways; or Liver-channel Damp-Heat pouring downward and disturbing Bladder Qi transformation.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 腎為水臟，主司二便，膀胱與腎相表裡，賴腎氣的溫煦固攝以司開闔；腎氣不足則膀胱失約，睡中遺尿；肺脾氣虛，上虛不能制下，亦致膀胱失約；濕熱下注膀胱，氣化失司，亦可擾動而遺尿。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Kidney is the Water organ governing urination and defecation; the Bladder is exteriorly-interiorly linked with the Kidney and relies on Kidney Qi's warming and consolidating action to control opening and closing. When Kidney Qi is insufficient, the Bladder loses restraint and enuresis occurs during sleep. Lung-Spleen Qi deficiency ("upper deficiency failing to control the lower") likewise causes loss of Bladder restraint; Damp-Heat pouring into the Bladder can also disturb Qi transformation and produce enuresis.
key_manifestations_zh: 睡眠中不自覺排尿，醒後方知
可一夜一次或多次，甚則每夜遺尿
兼見面色蒼白、肢冷畏寒、腰膝痠軟（腎氣不固者）
兼見神疲乏力、食欲不振、自汗（肺脾氣虛者）
兼見尿黃、尿味臊臭、性情急躁（肝經濕熱者）
key_manifestations_en: Involuntary urination during sleep, noticed only after waking
May occur once or multiple times per night, or nightly in severe cases
Pale complexion, cold limbs, aversion to cold, and lower back/knee soreness (Kidney Qi not firm)
Fatigue, poor appetite, and spontaneous sweating (Lung-Spleen Qi deficiency)
Dark, strong-smelling urine and irritability (Liver-channel Damp-Heat)
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在膀胱，與腎、肺、脾、肝關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Bladder, closely related to the Kidney, Lung, Spleen, and Liver.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以固攝膀胱為要，腎氣不固者溫腎固攝，肺脾氣虛者補肺健脾、益氣攝尿，肝經濕熱者清肝瀉火利濕。
records.treatment_principle_en: The key is to consolidate and restrain the Bladder. For Kidney Qi not firm, warm the Kidney and consolidate restraint; for Lung-Spleen Qi deficiency, tonify the Lung, strengthen the Spleen, and boost Qi to control urination; for Liver-channel Damp-Heat, clear the Liver, drain Fire, and disinhibit Dampness.

red_flags_zh.finding: 遺尿或排尿症狀合併發燒、腰背或側腹疼痛、嘔吐或發抖畏寒
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示泌尿道感染或腎盂腎炎
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Frequent or urgent urination" (ency/article/003140.htm), When to Contact a Medical Professional, retrieved 2026-08-11: "You have fever, back or side pain, vomiting, or shaking chills"

red_flags_zh.finding: 合併明顯口渴、食慾增加、疲倦或不明原因體重下降
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 建議轉介評估血糖及內分泌狀況
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除糖尿病等代謝性病因
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Frequent or urgent urination" (ency/article/003140.htm), When to Contact a Medical Professional, retrieved 2026-08-11: "You have increased thirst or appetite, fatigue, or sudden weight loss"

red_flags_zh.finding: 尿液帶血或混濁
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除泌尿道感染、結石或其他病理性血尿
red_flags_zh.source: MedlinePlus "Frequent or urgent urination" (ency/article/003140.htm), When to Contact a Medical Professional, retrieved 2026-08-11: "You have bloody or cloudy urine"

red_flags_en.finding: Enuresis or urinary symptoms with fever, back/flank pain, vomiting, or shaking chills
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests urinary tract infection or pyelonephritis
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus "Frequent or urgent urination" (ency/article/003140.htm), When to Contact a Medical Professional, retrieved 2026-08-11: "You have fever, back or side pain, vomiting, or shaking chills"

red_flags_en.finding: With marked thirst, increased appetite, fatigue, or unexplained weight loss
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Recommend referral to evaluate blood glucose and endocrine status
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out diabetes and other metabolic causes
red_flags_en.source: MedlinePlus "Frequent or urgent urination" (ency/article/003140.htm), When to Contact a Medical Professional, retrieved 2026-08-11: "You have increased thirst or appetite, fatigue, or sudden weight loss"

red_flags_en.finding: Bloody or cloudy urine

records.definition_zh: 遺精是指不因性交而精液頻繁遺泄的病證，有夢而遺者稱「夢遺」，無夢而遺甚至清醒時精液自出者稱「滑精」。
records.definition_en: Seminal Emission (遺精) refers to frequent involuntary discharge of semen without sexual intercourse. When it occurs with dreaming it is called "dream emission" (夢遺); when it occurs without dreams, or even while awake, it is called "slippery emission" (滑精).
records.etiology_zh: 多因君相火旺、擾動精室；或腎氣不固、精關不藏；或濕熱下注，擾動精室；亦可因勞心過度、房事不節，耗傷腎精。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by hyperactive Ministerial/Sovereign Fire disturbing the seminal chamber; Kidney Qi not firm with failure of the seminal gate to store; Damp-Heat pouring downward and disturbing the seminal chamber; or excessive mental strain and unrestrained sexual activity depleting Kidney Essence.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 腎藏精，肝主疏泄，精室的開闔有賴心腎相交、水火既濟；若心腎不交，相火妄動，擾動精室則夢遺頻作；久病腎虛精關不固，則無夢滑精；濕熱下注，擾動精室，亦可致遺精。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Kidney stores Essence and the Liver governs free-flow; the opening and closing of the seminal chamber depend on the Heart and Kidney communicating, with Water and Fire in balance. When the Heart and Kidney fail to communicate, Ministerial Fire stirs recklessly and disturbs the seminal chamber, producing frequent dream emissions. With prolonged illness, Kidney deficiency loosens the seminal gate, producing emission without dreams. Damp-Heat pouring downward and disturbing the seminal chamber can likewise cause emission.
key_manifestations_zh: 有夢而遺精，寐則遺泄
無夢而遺，甚則清醒時精自滑出
兼見心煩失眠、頭暈耳鳴、腰膝痠軟
兼見神疲乏力、面色晄白、畏寒肢冷（腎氣不固者）
兼見陰囊潮濕、小便黃赤、口苦（濕熱下注者）
key_manifestations_en: Emission occurring with dreams during sleep
Emission without dreams, or even involuntary discharge while awake in severe cases
Vexation, insomnia, dizziness, tinnitus, and lower back/knee soreness
Fatigue, pale complexion, and cold aversion with cold limbs (Kidney Qi not firm)
Scrotal dampness, dark-yellow urine, and bitter taste in the mouth (Damp-Heat pouring downward)
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在腎，與心、肝關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Kidney, closely related to the Heart and Liver.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 心腎不交者交通心腎、清心安神，腎氣不固者補腎固精，濕熱下注者清熱利濕。
records.treatment_principle_en: For Heart-Kidney not communicating, connect the Heart and Kidney and clear the Heart to calm the Spirit; for Kidney Qi not firm, tonify the Kidney and secure the Essence; for Damp-Heat pouring downward, clear Heat and disinhibit Dampness.

red_flags_zh.finding: 射精時或射精後劇烈不適，合併發燒、寒顫或血尿
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除前列腺炎或泌尿道感染

records.definition_zh: 陽痿是指成年男子性交時，陰莖不能勃起，或勃起不堅，或堅而不能持久，以致不能完成正常性生活的病證。
records.definition_en: Impotence (陽痿) refers to a condition in adult men where the penis fails to become erect during intercourse, or the erection is insufficiently firm, or firm but not sustained, preventing completion of normal sexual activity.
records.etiology_zh: 多因房事不節、手淫過度，命門火衰；或思慮傷脾、憂鬱傷肝，情志不遂；或濕熱下注，宗筋弛縱；或驚恐傷腎，腎氣不固。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by excessive sexual activity or masturbation depleting Life-Gate Fire; overthinking damaging the Spleen or depression damaging the Liver with unresolved emotion; Damp-Heat pouring downward and slackening the ancestral sinew; or fright damaging the Kidney and unsettling Kidney Qi.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 陰莖為宗筋所聚，其勃起有賴腎陽溫煦、肝之疏泄、心神調攝；命門火衰，宗筋失於溫煦，則陽事不舉；肝鬱氣滯，或濕熱下注宗筋，亦可致陽痿；久病及心脾，心脾兩虛，氣血不足，宗筋失養。
records.pathomechanism_en: The penis is where the ancestral sinews converge; erection depends on the warming of Kidney Yang, the free-flow governed by the Liver, and regulation by the Heart-Spirit. When Life-Gate Fire declines, the ancestral sinew loses its warming and fails to rise. Liver Qi stagnation, or Damp-Heat pouring into the ancestral sinew, can likewise cause impotence. With prolonged illness affecting the Heart and Spleen, Heart-Spleen deficiency and Qi-Blood insufficiency leave the ancestral sinew unnourished.
key_manifestations_zh: 陰莖不能勃起，或勃起不堅、不能持久
腰膝痠軟、畏寒肢冷、精神萎靡（命門火衰者）
情緒抑鬱、胸脅脹悶、興趣減退（肝鬱氣滯者）
陰囊潮濕臊臭、小便黃赤（濕熱下注者）
心悸失眠、神疲納差（心脾兩虛者）
key_manifestations_en: Inability to achieve erection, or erection that is insufficiently firm or not sustained
Lower back/knee soreness, cold aversion with cold limbs, and low spirits (Life-Gate Fire decline)
Depressed mood, chest and hypochondriac fullness, and diminished interest (Liver Qi stagnation)
Damp, malodorous scrotum and dark-yellow urine (Damp-Heat pouring downward)
Palpitations, insomnia, fatigue, and poor appetite (Heart-Spleen deficiency)
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在宗筋，與腎、肝、心、脾關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the ancestral sinew (penis), closely related to the Kidney, Liver, Heart, and Spleen.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 命門火衰者溫腎壯陽，肝鬱氣滯者疏肝解鬱，濕熱下注者清熱利濕，心脾兩虛者補益心脾。
records.treatment_principle_en: For Life-Gate Fire decline, warm the Kidney and strengthen Yang; for Liver Qi stagnation, soothe the Liver and resolve depression; for Damp-Heat pouring downward, clear Heat and disinhibit Dampness; for Heart-Spleen deficiency, tonify the Heart and Spleen.

red_flags_zh.finding: 勃起功能障礙新發或逐漸加重，尤其合併心血管危險因子
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 建議轉介評估心血管及內分泌狀況
red_flags_zh.rationale: 勃起功能障礙可能是血管疾病的早期徵象

red_flags_en.recommended_action: Recommend referral to evaluate cardiovascular and endocrine status
red_flags_en.rationale: Erectile dysfunction may be an early sign of vascular disease

records.definition_zh: 耳鳴耳聾是以自覺耳中鳴響或聽力減退甚至喪失為主要表現的病證，耳鳴為聽覺異常，耳聾為聽覺障礙，二者病因病機相通，常同時或先後出現。
records.definition_en: Er Ming Er Long (Tinnitus and Deafness) is characterized by a subjective ringing sensation in the ear or reduced/lost hearing; tinnitus is auditory disturbance and deafness is hearing impairment, sharing the same etiology and pathomechanism, often appearing together or sequentially.
records.etiology_zh: 外感風邪，上壅耳竅；情志不遂，肝火上擾；飲食不節，痰火上蒸；久病體虛，腎精虧損，耳竅失養。
records.etiology_en: External Wind congesting upward into the ear orifice; emotional frustration causing Liver Fire to disturb upward; dietary irregularity generating Phlegm-Fire that steams upward; or chronic debility with Kidney Essence depletion depriving the ear orifice of nourishment.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 耳為腎之竅，又為宗脈之所聚；肝膽經脈亦循行於耳；凡風邪、肝火、痰火壅滯清竅，或腎精不足、氣血虛弱不能上榮耳竅，皆可致耳鳴耳聾；暴聾多屬實證，漸聾久聾多屬虛證。
records.pathomechanism_en: The ear is the orifice of the Kidney and the meeting point of the ancestral vessels; the Liver and Gallbladder channels also pass through the ear. Wind, Liver Fire, or Phlegm-Fire congesting the clear orifice, or Kidney Essence insufficiency and Qi-Blood weakness failing to nourish the ear orifice, can all cause tinnitus and deafness. Sudden deafness is usually an excess pattern; gradual or chronic deafness is usually a deficiency pattern.
key_manifestations_zh: 耳中鳴響，如蟬鳴或潮聲
聽力減退或喪失
實證者耳鳴暴發、聲大如潮，按之不減
虛證者耳鳴時作時止，聲細如蟬，勞累加重
可伴眩暈、腰膝痠軟
key_manifestations_en: Ringing in the ear, like cicada chirping or tidal roar
Reduced or lost hearing
Excess type: sudden loud tinnitus like tidal roar, unrelieved by pressure
Deficiency type: intermittent faint cicada-like tinnitus, worsened by exertion
May accompany dizziness and sore, weak lower back and knees
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在耳，與腎、肝膽相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the ear, related to the Kidney, Liver, and Gallbladder.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 實證清肝瀉火、化痰通竅；虛證補腎填精、益氣養血，佐以開竅通絡。
records.treatment_principle_en: Excess patterns: clear the Liver and drain Fire, transform Phlegm and open the orifice. Deficiency patterns: tonify the Kidney and replenish Essence, benefit Qi and nourish Blood, assisted by opening the orifice and unblocking the vessels.

red_flags_zh.finding: 突發且嚴重的聽力喪失，或突然出現耳鳴
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即就醫，盡快於72小時內至耳鼻喉科評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 突發性感音神經性聽力喪失屬耳科急症，黃金治療期短，延誤恐致永久性聽損

red_flags_zh.finding: 聽力喪失合併耳痛，或新出現的頭痛、肢體無力或麻木
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速就醫評估神經系統病因
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能提示中樞神經系統病變

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden, severe hearing loss, or sudden onset of tinnitus
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek immediate ENT evaluation, ideally within 72 hours
red_flags_en.rationale: Sudden sensorineural hearing loss is an otologic emergency with a narrow treatment window; delay risks permanent hearing loss

red_flags_en.finding: Hearing loss with ear pain, or new headache, limb weakness, or numbness
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate central nervous system pathology

records.definition_zh: 腰痛是以腰部一側或兩側疼痛為主症的病證，可急性發作亦可反覆遷延，是內科、傷科皆常見的病證。
records.definition_en: Yao Tong (Lumbar Pain) is a disease characterized by pain in one or both sides of the lower back. It may present acutely or as a recurrent, chronic complaint, and is common in both internal medicine and orthopedic-traumatology practice.
records.etiology_zh: 多因外感風寒濕邪、跌仆閃挫、久坐久立勞損，或年老腎虧所致；腎為腰之府，腎虛為腰痛的重要內因。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by external Wind-Cold-Damp invasion, trauma or a sudden wrenching strain, chronic strain from prolonged sitting or standing, or age-related Kidney depletion. The Kidney "resides" in the lower back, making Kidney vacuity a key internal cause of lumbar pain.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 腎虛則腰府失養、隱隱作痛;寒濕、濕熱之邪痺阻腰部經脈,或跌仆傷絡、瘀血阻滯,皆令腰部氣血不通而痛,不榮則痛與不通則痛可並見。
records.pathomechanism_en: Kidney vacuity leaves the lumbar region unnourished, producing a dull, lingering ache. Cold-Damp or Damp-Heat obstructing the lumbar channels, or trauma injuring the network vessels with Blood stasis, obstruct the local flow of Qi and Blood and cause pain — the two mechanisms of "lack of nourishment" and "lack of free flow" may coexist.
key_manifestations_zh: 腰部一側或兩側疼痛
痠痛、脹痛、刺痛或冷痛（隨證不同）
勞累後加重、休息可緩解（腎虛型）
陰雨天或受寒加重（寒濕型）
痛處固定、夜間加重（瘀血型）
key_manifestations_en: Pain in one or both sides of the lower back
Aching, distending, stabbing, or cold pain (varies by pattern)
Worsened by exertion, relieved by rest (Kidney-vacuity type)
Worsened by rainy weather or cold exposure (Cold-Damp type)
Fixed location, worse at night (Blood-stasis type)
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在腰部經絡，與腎關係最密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the lumbar channels, most closely related to the Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 腎虛者補腎為主（陽虛溫補、陰虛滋補），寒濕者溫經散寒除濕，濕熱者清熱利濕，瘀血者活血化瘀通絡。
records.treatment_principle_en: For Kidney vacuity, tonify the Kidney (warmly for Yang deficiency, nourishingly for Yin deficiency); for Cold-Damp, warm the channels and dispel Cold-Damp; for Damp-Heat, clear Heat and disinhibit Dampness; for Blood stasis, invigorate Blood and unblock the network vessels.

red_flags_zh.finding: 鞍區麻木、大小便失禁或滯留、雙下肢無力
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即急診，考慮馬尾症候群
red_flags_zh.rationale: 馬尾症候群為外科急症，延誤治療可致永久性神經損傷

red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除腫瘤轉移或脊椎感染

red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除壓迫性骨折

red_flags_zh.finding: 進行性足下垂或明顯肌力下降
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示神經根受壓迫惡化

records.definition_zh: 痺證是因風、寒、濕、熱等外邪侵襲肢體、經絡、關節，導致氣血運行不暢，出現肌肉、筋骨、關節疼痛、麻木、重著、屈伸不利，甚則關節腫大變形的病證。
records.definition_en: Bi Zheng (Bi Syndrome / Painful Obstruction) results from Wind, Cold, Damp, or Heat pathogens invading the limbs, channels, and joints, obstructing the flow of Qi and Blood and producing pain, numbness, heaviness, and restricted movement of muscles, sinews, bones, and joints, with severe cases showing joint swelling and deformity.
records.etiology_zh: 多因居處潮濕、氣候寒冷、涉水冒雨、汗出當風，正氣不足、腠理疏鬆，風寒濕熱之邪乘虛侵入肢體經絡所致。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by living in a damp environment, exposure to cold weather, wading through water or being caught in rain, or sweating and then being exposed to wind — when the correct Qi is insufficient and the striae are loose, Wind, Cold, Damp, or Heat pathogens take advantage to invade the limbs and channels.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 外邪侵襲肢體經絡,阻遏氣血運行,不通則痛;風邪偏盛則痛處遊走（行痺）,寒邪偏盛則痛劇而定處（痛痺）,濕邪偏盛則重著腫脹（著痺）,熱邪偏盛則紅腫灼痛（熱痺）;病久邪留關節,痰瘀互結,可致關節腫大變形。
records.pathomechanism_en: External pathogens invading the limb channels obstruct the flow of Qi and Blood — "no free flow, hence pain." A predominance of Wind produces migratory pain (Wandering Bi); a predominance of Cold produces severe fixed pain (Painful Bi); a predominance of Dampness produces heaviness and swelling (Fixed Bi); a predominance of Heat produces redness, swelling, and burning pain (Heat Bi). Chronic retention of the pathogen in the joints, with Phlegm and stasis intertwining, can lead to joint swelling and deformity.
key_manifestations_zh: 肢體關節疼痛
關節腫脹或屈伸不利
肌膚麻木、重著感
疼痛遊走不定或固定不移（隨證不同）
遇寒或陰雨天加重（寒濕型）
key_manifestations_en: Limb and joint pain
Joint swelling or restricted flexion/extension
Numbness or a heavy sensation in the skin/muscles
Migratory or fixed pain (varies by pattern)
Worsened by cold or rainy weather (Cold-Damp type)
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在肢體、經絡、關節，與肝、脾、腎相關（久痺傷及肝腎）。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the limbs, channels, and joints, related to the Liver, Spleen, and Kidney (chronic Bi injures the Liver and Kidney).
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以祛風散寒、除濕清熱、通經活絡為總則，隨風、寒、濕、熱偏盛加減；久痺兼顧補益肝腎、化痰祛瘀。
records.treatment_principle_en: The overall principle is to dispel Wind, disperse Cold, eliminate Dampness, clear Heat, and unblock the channels — modified according to which pathogen predominates. Chronic Bi additionally requires tonifying the Liver and Kidney while transforming Phlegm and dispelling stasis.

red_flags_zh.finding: 單一關節突然紅、腫、熱、劇痛，合併發燒、寒顫，且該關節無法活動
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除化膿性（感染性）關節炎，屬醫療急症，延誤治療可致永久關節損傷

red_flags_zh.finding: 關節劇痛快速發作
red_flags_zh.rationale: 及早治療可減少關節損傷

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden red, swollen, hot, severely painful single joint with fever/chills and inability to move the joint
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Go to the emergency department or call for an ambulance immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out septic (infectious) arthritis, a medical emergency — delayed treatment can cause permanent joint damage

red_flags_en.finding: Rapid-onset severe joint pain
red_flags_en.rationale: Early treatment reduces joint damage

records.definition_zh: 痿證是以肢體筋脈弛緩、軟弱無力，不能隨意運動，甚則肌肉萎縮為主要表現的病證，病位在筋脈肌肉，與五臟關係密切，尤以肺、脾、肝、腎為要。
records.definition_en: Wei Zheng (Wei Syndrome, Atrophy-Flaccidity) is characterized by flaccid, weak sinews and limbs with loss of voluntary movement, severe cases showing muscle atrophy; the disease location is the sinews and muscles, closely related to all five Zang organs, especially the Lung, Spleen, Liver, and Kidney.
records.etiology_zh: 溫熱邪毒傷肺，肺熱葉焦；濕熱浸淫筋脈；脾胃虛弱，精微不布；肝腎虧損，精血不能濡養筋脈。
records.etiology_en: Warm-Heat toxin injuring the Lung and scorching the Lung lobes; Damp-Heat soaking into the sinews; Spleen-Stomach weakness failing to distribute nutrient essence; or Liver-Kidney depletion with Essence-Blood unable to nourish the sinews.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肺主身之皮毛，為水之上源；脾主四肢肌肉；肝主筋，腎主骨生髓；凡邪熱傷肺、濕熱浸淫、脾胃虛弱或肝腎虧損，皆可致精血津液不能濡養筋脈肌肉，「宗筋失養，弛縱不收」而成痿。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Lung governs the body's skin and hair and is the upper source of water; the Spleen governs the limbs and muscles; the Liver governs the sinews and the Kidney governs bones and generates marrow. Pathogenic Heat injuring the Lung, Damp-Heat soaking in, Spleen-Stomach weakness, or Liver-Kidney depletion can all leave Essence, Blood, and fluids unable to nourish the sinews and muscles — "the governing sinews lose nourishment and become flaccid" — producing Wei syndrome.
key_manifestations_zh: 肢體筋脈弛緩，軟弱無力
不能隨意運動，甚則肌肉萎縮
可由下肢開始，漸及上肢
病情進展可見呼吸肌無力
久病可伴肌肉萎縮、皮膚枯槁
key_manifestations_en: Flaccid sinews and limbs, weakness
Loss of voluntary movement, severe cases with muscle atrophy
May begin in the lower limbs and progress to the upper limbs
Progression may involve respiratory muscle weakness
Chronic cases: muscle atrophy and withered skin
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在筋脈肌肉，與肺、脾胃、肝腎相關。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the sinews and muscles, related to the Lung, Spleen-Stomach, and Liver-Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 肺熱津傷者清熱潤肺、養陰生津；濕熱浸淫者清熱利濕、通利筋脈；脾胃虛弱者健脾益氣、補養氣血；肝腎虧損者滋補肝腎、填精益髓；「治痿獨取陽明」為歷代治療要旨。
records.treatment_principle_en: Lung Heat injuring fluids: clear Heat and moisten the Lung, nourish Yin and generate fluids. Damp-Heat soaking in: clear Heat and drain Dampness, unblock the sinews. Spleen-Stomach weakness: strengthen the Spleen and tonify Qi, nourish Qi and Blood. Liver-Kidney depletion: nourish the Liver and Kidney, replenish Essence and Marrow. The classical principle "to treat Wei, take Yangming alone" (treating the Stomach-Spleen) has guided treatment across generations.

red_flags_zh.finding: 下肢無力迅速向上蔓延至軀幹、上肢甚至呼吸肌，或出現呼吸困難
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即送急診，可能需要呼吸器支持
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示格林-巴利症候群等急性上升性麻痺，屬神經科急症，重症可危及呼吸

red_flags_en.recommended_action: Go to the emergency department immediately; may require ventilatory support
red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests acute ascending paralysis such as Guillain-Barre syndrome, a neurological emergency that can be life-threatening in severe cases

records.definition_zh: 筋傷是指因外力損傷、勞損或感受外邪，導致筋（肌腱、韌帶、關節囊等軟組織）受損，出現局部腫痛、活動受限的病證。
records.definition_en: Sinew Injury (筋傷) refers to damage to the sinews (tendons, ligaments, joint capsules, and other soft tissues) caused by external trauma, overuse strain, or invasion of external pathogens, presenting as localized swelling, pain, and restricted movement.
records.etiology_zh: 多因跌仆閃挫、持重用力不當，或勞損積累，損傷筋脈；亦可因久居濕地、感受風寒濕邪，痹阻筋脈。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by falls, sprains, or wrenching, or improper force during lifting; may also result from cumulative overuse strain, or from dwelling in damp environments where Wind-Cold-Damp invades and obstructs the sinews and channels.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 外傷或勞損使局部經絡受損，氣血運行不暢，瘀血阻滯，不通則痛，發為腫痛；病久氣滯血瘀不去，或風寒濕邪痹阻，可致筋脈失養、屈伸不利；反覆損傷或年老體衰者，肝腎虧虛，筋失所養，更易復發。
records.pathomechanism_en: Trauma or overuse damages the local channels, impeding the flow of Qi and Blood; Blood stasis obstructs the channels, and pain results from lack of free flow, producing swelling and pain. If Qi stagnation and Blood stasis persist, or Wind-Cold-Damp remains lodged, the sinews become unnourished and flexion-extension is impaired. With repeated injury or in the elderly, Liver-Kidney deficiency leaves the sinews unnourished, predisposing to recurrence.
key_manifestations_zh: 局部腫脹、疼痛，按之痛甚
關節或肢體活動受限，屈伸不利
傷處可見瘀斑、皮下瘀血（急性期）
慢性者局部酸脹、遇勞加重、遇寒加重
反覆發作或年老者常兼腰膝痠軟、筋脈拘急
key_manifestations_en: Localized swelling and pain, worse with pressure
Restricted joint or limb movement, difficulty with flexion and extension
Bruising and subcutaneous hemorrhage at the injury site (acute stage)
Chronic cases with local aching and distension, worsened by exertion or cold
Recurrent cases or in the elderly, often accompanied by lower back/knee soreness and sinew tightness
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在受傷局部之筋脈、關節，與肝、腎關係密切（肝主筋，腎主骨）。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the sinews and joints at the site of injury, closely related to the Liver and Kidney (the Liver governs the sinews, the Kidney governs the bones).
records.treatment_principle_zh: 急性期以活血化瘀、消腫止痛為主；慢性期以舒筋活絡、補益肝腎為法。
records.treatment_principle_en: In the acute stage, invigorate Blood, resolve stasis, reduce swelling, and relieve pain; in the chronic stage, relax the sinews, free the channels, and tonify the Liver and Kidney.

records.definition_zh: 落枕是指因睡姿不當或頸部受風寒，晨起後突發頸項強痛、轉側不利的病證，多能自行或經治療於一至二週內緩解。
records.definition_en: Stiff Neck (落枕) refers to sudden onset of neck pain and stiffness with restricted rotation upon waking, typically caused by an awkward sleeping posture or exposure of the neck to Wind-Cold; it usually resolves spontaneously or with treatment within one to two weeks.
records.etiology_zh: 多因睡眠姿勢不當，頸部肌肉長時間受牽拉；或夜臥受風寒侵襲頸項經絡，氣血凝滯；素體氣血不足、頸部經筋失養者更易發作。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by an awkward sleeping posture that stretches the neck muscles for a prolonged period, or Wind-Cold invading the neck channels during sleep and causing Qi-Blood to congeal; those with underlying Qi-Blood insufficiency and undernourished neck sinews are more prone to episodes.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 頸項經筋因姿勢不當或風寒侵襲，局部氣血運行受阻，經脈拘急，不通則痛，發為頸項強痛、活動受限。
records.pathomechanism_en: The sinew channels of the neck become locally obstructed in Qi-Blood flow due to an awkward posture or Wind-Cold invasion; the channels become tense and contracted, producing pain from lack of free flow, presenting as neck stiffness, pain, and restricted movement.
key_manifestations_zh: 晨起突發頸項強痛，多為一側
頭項轉側活動受限，動則痛甚
可觸及局部肌肉緊張、壓痛
疼痛可牽及肩背
一般無發熱、上肢放射麻木等全身或神經症狀
key_manifestations_en: Sudden onset of one-sided neck pain and stiffness upon waking
Restricted turning of the head and neck, with pain worsened by movement
Palpable local muscle tension and tenderness
Pain may radiate to the shoulder and upper back
Generally no fever or radiating arm numbness/systemic or neurologic symptoms
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在頸項筋脈，屬太陽、少陽經筋為主。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the sinew channels of the neck, mainly involving the Taiyang and Shaoyang sinew channels.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以祛風散寒、舒筋活絡、行氣活血為法。
records.treatment_principle_en: The method is to expel Wind, dispel Cold, relax the sinews, free the channels, and move Qi and Blood.

red_flags_en.finding: Radiating arm numbness or weakness
red_flags_en.rationale: Consider radiculopathy

records.definition_zh: 肩凝症又稱漏肩風、五十肩，是以肩部疼痛、活動受限，日久肩部肌肉萎縮、狀如凝結為主症的病證，好發於50歲左右。
records.definition_en: Frozen Shoulder (肩凝症), also called "leaking-shoulder wind" (漏肩風) or "fifty-shoulder" (五十肩), is characterized by shoulder pain and restricted movement, with muscle atrophy developing over time as if the joint had "frozen"; it most often occurs around age 50.
records.etiology_zh: 多因年老體衰、氣血漸虧，肩部經脈失養；或勞損外傷，筋脈受損；或睡臥露肩，風寒濕邪乘虛侵襲肩部經絡，痹阻氣血。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by advancing age with declining Qi-Blood leaving the shoulder channels unnourished; or overuse strain and trauma damaging the sinews; or sleeping with the shoulder exposed, allowing Wind-Cold-Damp to invade the shoulder channels while defenses are weak and obstruct Qi-Blood flow.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肩部經脈氣血本已漸虛，復感風寒濕邪，或勞損傷及筋脈，致使局部氣血凝滯、經脈痹阻，不通則痛；病久氣血虛損，筋脈失於濡養，則肩部活動日漸受限，肌肉萎縮。
records.pathomechanism_en: With the shoulder channels' Qi-Blood already gradually deficient, further invasion by Wind-Cold-Damp, or strain damaging the sinews, causes local Qi-Blood to congeal and the channels to become obstructed, producing pain from lack of free flow. With prolonged illness, Qi-Blood deficiency leaves the sinews unnourished, so shoulder movement becomes progressively restricted and the muscles atrophy.
key_manifestations_zh: 肩部疼痛，夜間或遇冷加重
肩關節活動範圍逐漸縮小，外展、上舉、後伸受限
病程日久可見肩部肌肉萎縮
疼痛可牽及上臂，但一般無手部麻木無力
病情發展多分為疼痛期、僵硬期、緩解期
key_manifestations_en: Shoulder pain, worsened at night or with cold exposure
Progressively decreasing range of shoulder motion — restricted abduction, elevation, and extension behind the back
Muscle atrophy of the shoulder in long-standing cases
Pain may radiate to the upper arm, but generally without hand numbness or weakness
The course typically passes through painful, stiffening, and resolving stages
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在肩部經筋，與手三陽經關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the sinew channels of the shoulder, closely related to the three Hand Yang channels.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 早期以祛風散寒除濕、通絡止痛為主，後期以益氣養血、舒筋活絡為法，並配合功能鍛鍊。
records.treatment_principle_en: In the early stage, expel Wind, dispel Cold, eliminate Dampness, and free the channels to relieve pain; in the later stage, tonify Qi, nourish Blood, and relax the sinews to free the channels, combined with functional exercise.

red_flags_zh.finding: 外傷後突發無力或畸形
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除旋轉肌撕裂或骨折

red_flags_zh.finding: 夜間痛合併體重減輕或發燒
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除感染或腫瘤

red_flags_zh.finding: 被動活動不受限卻無力
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能是旋轉肌問題而非冰凍肩

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden weakness or deformity after trauma
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out rotator cuff tear or fracture

red_flags_en.finding: Night pain with weight loss or fever
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out infection or tumor

red_flags_en.finding: Full passive range of motion but with weakness
red_flags_en.rationale: Likely rotator cuff pathology rather than adhesive capsulitis

records.definition_zh: 痛經是指婦女正值經期或行經前後，出現週期性小腹疼痛，或痛引腰骶，甚則劇痛暈厥的病證。
records.definition_en: Tong Jing (Dysmenorrhea) refers to cyclical lower abdominal pain occurring during, or just before/after, menstruation, sometimes radiating to the lower back and sacrum, with severe cases causing fainting.
records.etiology_zh: 多因情志不遂、肝氣鬱結，經期感寒飲冷、寒濕凝滯，或素體氣血虛弱、肝腎虧損，以致沖任、胞宮氣血運行不暢或失於濡養。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by emotional stress with Liver Qi stagnation; exposure to cold or cold drinks during menstruation causing Cold-Damp congelation; or an underlying Qi-Blood weakness or Liver-Kidney deficiency, resulting in impaired flow or insufficient nourishment of the Chong-Ren vessels and uterus.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 經前經期氣血下注沖任、胞宮，若氣滯血瘀或寒凝血瘀，則經血運行不暢，不通則痛;若氣血虛弱、肝腎虧損，胞宮失於濡養，則不榮則痛。
records.pathomechanism_en: Around and during menstruation, Qi and Blood pour down into the Chong-Ren vessels and uterus. If Qi stagnation and Blood stasis, or Cold congealing the Blood, obstruct this flow, pain results from lack of free flow. If Qi-Blood is weak or the Liver-Kidney is deficient, the uterus is left unnourished, and pain results from lack of nourishment.
key_manifestations_zh: 經期或經前後小腹疼痛
疼痛呈週期性，與月經同步
可痛引腰骶
經量、經色、經質異常（隨證不同）
重者伴噁心嘔吐、冷汗淋漓甚則暈厥
key_manifestations_en: Lower abdominal pain during or around menstruation
Cyclical pain synchronized with the menstrual cycle
May radiate to the lower back and sacrum
Abnormal flow volume, color, or consistency (varies by pattern)
Severe cases with nausea, vomiting, cold sweating, or fainting
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在沖任、胞宮，與肝、腎關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Chong-Ren vessels and uterus, closely related to the Liver and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以調理沖任氣血為總則：氣滯血瘀者理氣活血化瘀，寒凝者溫經散寒，濕熱者清熱除濕化瘀，氣血虛弱者益氣養血，肝腎虧損者滋補肝腎。
records.treatment_principle_en: The overall principle is to regulate Qi and Blood in the Chong-Ren vessels: for Qi stagnation with Blood stasis, regulate Qi and invigorate Blood; for Cold congelation, warm the channels and dispel Cold; for Damp-Heat, clear Heat, eliminate Dampness, and resolve stasis; for Qi-Blood weakness, tonify Qi and nourish Blood; for Liver-Kidney deficiency, nourish the Liver and Kidney.

records.definition_zh: 月經先期是指月經週期提前七天以上，甚至一月兩至，連續兩個週期以上者。
records.definition_en: Early Menstruation (月經先期) refers to a menstrual cycle that arrives seven or more days earlier than expected, sometimes twice within one month, for two or more consecutive cycles.
records.etiology_zh: 多因素體陽盛，或飲食辛辣助熱，血分伏熱，熱迫血行；或憂思傷脾、脾氣虛弱，統攝無權；或稟賦不足、房勞多產,腎氣虛弱,封藏失職。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by underlying Yang excess, or spicy/heating foods generating latent Heat in the Blood that forces Blood to move recklessly; or worry and overthinking damaging the Spleen, weakening its governing function over the Blood; or congenital insufficiency and childbearing/sexual strain weakening Kidney Qi and its storing function.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 血熱者，熱擾沖任，迫血妄行，故經期提前；氣虛者，脾氣虛弱，統血無權，沖任不固，經血失於制約而先期而至；腎氣虛者，封藏失職，沖任不固，亦致經行提前。
records.pathomechanism_en: In Blood Heat, Heat disturbs the Chong-Ren vessels and forces the Blood to move recklessly, so the period arrives early. In Qi deficiency, weak Spleen Qi fails to govern the Blood, the Chong-Ren vessels lose their consolidation, and menstrual blood is released without restraint, arriving early. In Kidney Qi deficiency, the storing function fails and the Chong-Ren vessels are not secured, likewise causing early arrival.
key_manifestations_zh: 月經週期提前七天以上，甚至一月兩至
經色深紅或紫紅、質稠，量或多或少（血熱者）
經色淡紅、質稀，神疲肢倦、氣短懶言（氣虛者）
經量少、色淡黯、腰膝痠軟（腎虛者）
可伴心煩口渴、小便黃赤（實熱者）
key_manifestations_en: Menstrual cycle arriving seven or more days early, sometimes twice within one month
Deep-red or purplish-red, thick flow, volume variable (Blood Heat)
Pale-red, thin flow with fatigue, limb weariness, and shortness of breath with reluctance to speak (Qi deficiency)
Scant, pale-dark flow with lower back/knee soreness (Kidney deficiency)
May include vexation, thirst, and dark-yellow urine (excess Heat type)
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在沖任、胞宮，與脾、腎、肝關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Chong-Ren vessels and uterus, closely related to the Spleen, Kidney, and Liver.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 血熱者清熱涼血調經，氣虛者補氣攝血調經，腎虛者補腎固沖調經。
records.treatment_principle_en: For Blood Heat, clear Heat, cool the Blood, and regulate menstruation; for Qi deficiency, tonify Qi, secure the Blood, and regulate menstruation; for Kidney deficiency, tonify the Kidney, secure the Chong vessel, and regulate menstruation.

red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能是子宮內膜病變甚至癌症的早期徵象

red_flags_zh.finding: 大量出血合併貧血症狀
red_flags_zh.rationale: 大量出血合併貧血需即時處理

red_flags_zh.finding: 疑似懷孕
red_flags_zh.rationale: 月經異常需先排除懷孕

red_flags_zh.finding: 合併泌乳、視野缺損或頭痛
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除腦下垂體病變

red_flags_en.finding: Any postmenopausal bleeding
red_flags_en.rationale: May be an early sign of endometrial pathology or cancer

red_flags_en.finding: Heavy bleeding with anemia symptoms
red_flags_en.rationale: Heavy bleeding with anemia requires prompt treatment

red_flags_en.finding: Possible pregnancy
red_flags_en.rationale: Menstrual irregularity must first rule out pregnancy

red_flags_en.finding: With galactorrhea, visual-field loss, or headache
red_flags_en.rationale: Must rule out pituitary pathology

records.definition_zh: 月經後期是指月經週期延後七天以上，甚至四五十天一行，連續兩個週期以上者。
records.definition_en: Delayed Menstruation (月經後期) refers to a menstrual cycle arriving seven or more days late, sometimes as long as forty to fifty days between periods, for two or more consecutive cycles.
records.etiology_zh: 多因經期產後感受寒邪，或過食生冷,寒凝血脈；或素體陽虛,虛寒內生；或營血虧虛,血海不能按時滿溢；或情志不遂,肝鬱氣滯,或痰濕阻滯,血行不暢。
records.etiology_en: Commonly caused by Cold invading during menstruation or postpartum, or excessive consumption of raw/cold food congealing the Blood vessels; underlying Yang deficiency generating internal Cold; Nutritive-Blood insufficiency preventing the Sea of Blood from filling on schedule; or emotional distress with Liver Qi stagnation, or Phlegm-Damp obstruction impeding Blood flow.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 寒凝血脈，血行遲滯，血海不能按時滿溢，故經行延後；血虛者，血海空虛，滿溢遲緩，亦致後期；氣滯痰阻者，氣血運行不暢，血海蓄溢失常，經行亦延後。
records.pathomechanism_en: Cold congeals the Blood vessels and slows Blood flow, so the Sea of Blood cannot fill on schedule, delaying the period. In Blood deficiency, the Sea of Blood is empty and fills slowly, likewise delaying menstruation. In Qi stagnation or Phlegm obstruction, the movement of Qi-Blood is impeded and the storing-and-releasing of the Sea of Blood becomes abnormal, also delaying the period.
key_manifestations_zh: 月經週期延後七天以上，甚則四五十天一行
經色暗紅有塊、小腹冷痛拒按或喜溫喜按（寒凝者）
經量少、色淡、小腹隱痛喜按（血虛者）
經前乳房脹痛、胸脅脹悶（氣滯者）
經色淡黯質稠、形體肥胖、帶下量多（痰濕者）
key_manifestations_en: Menstrual cycle arriving seven or more days late, sometimes forty to fifty days between periods
Dark flow with clots, cold lower-abdominal pain worse with pressure or relieved by warmth/pressure (Cold congealing)
Scant, pale flow with vague lower-abdominal pain relieved by pressure (Blood deficiency)
Premenstrual breast distension and chest/hypochondriac fullness (Qi stagnation)
Pale-dark, thick flow with obesity and abundant vaginal discharge (Phlegm-Damp)
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在沖任、胞宮，與肝、脾、腎關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: Disease location is the Chong-Ren vessels and uterus, closely related to the Liver, Spleen, and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 寒凝者溫經散寒調經，血虛者補血調經，氣滯者理氣行滯調經，痰濕者化痰燥濕調經。
records.treatment_principle_en: For Cold congealing, warm the channels, dispel Cold, and regulate menstruation; for Blood deficiency, tonify the Blood and regulate menstruation; for Qi stagnation, regulate Qi, move stagnation, and regulate menstruation; for Phlegm-Damp, transform Phlegm, dry Dampness, and regulate menstruation.
